sa: तौ शोणिताक्तौ युध्येतां वानरौ वनचारिणौ। मेघाविव महाशब्देस्त मानौ परस्परम्॥
en: And these two monkeys ranging in the forest, fought with each other, having their persons bathed in blood, and roaring like to clouds.

sa: ताडितस्तेन तं क्रुद्धः समभिक्रम्य वेगतः। अभवच्छोणितोद्गारी सापीड इव पर्वतः॥
en: Thereupon being struck by Vāli, waxing worth and approaching him quickly he began to vomit out gore like to a mountain having springs.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच अहितेषु कथं ब्रह्मन् प्रवर्तेयमतन्द्रितः। असमुच्छिद्य चैवैतान् नियच्छेयमुपायतः॥
en: Indra said How, O twice-born one, should I treat my enemies? How should I subdue them by various contrivances, without rooting them out?

sa: पत्त्यश्वरथनागौघैः पतितैर्विषमीकृताम्। द्रवते तद् यथा सैन्यं तेन भग्नं महात्मना॥
en: Rendered uneven by the slain foot-soldiers, horses, car-warriors and elephants. Yonder the Kaurava array is giving way being routed by that high-souled warrior.

sa: शैलोपलप्रस्खलमानवेगाः शैलोत्तमानां विपुलाः प्रपाताः। गुहासु संनादितबर्हिणासु हारा विकीर्यन्त इवावभान्ति॥
en: The heavy mountain waterfalls, loosening the rocks and stretching over the caves filled with the cries of peacocks, are appearing like a pearlnecklace.

sa: असुराणां समृद्धानां विनाशश्च त्वया कृतः। तव विक्रमणैर्देवा निर्वाणमगमन् परम्॥
en: It was you who destroyed the Asuras when they were in their great affluence. Through your prowess the celestials obtained peace and happiness.

sa: न मन्त्रबलवीर्येण प्रज्ञया पौरुषेण च। न शीलेन न वृत्तेन तथा नैवार्थसम्पदा। अलभ्यं लभते मर्त्यस्तत्र का परिदेवना॥
en: Can a person by Mantras, strength, energy, wisdom, prowess, behaviour, conduct, or wealth, acquire that which has not been ordained to be acquired by him? What sorrow then is there if a person cannot acquire that which he seeks at heart.

sa: शिरोभिः पतितै ति पततां धरणीतले। च्युतानामिव तालेभ्यस्तालानां श्रूयते स्वनः॥
en: The sound, made, O monarch, by heads falling on the field of battle, resembled that made by the falling fruits of palmyra trees.

sa: दद्यान्न प्रतिगृह्णीयात् सत्यं ब्रूयान्न चानृतम्। अपि जीवितहेतोहि रामः सत्यपराक्रमः॥
en: Rāma, having truth for his prowess, never, for his life, takes back what her gives, never speaks an untruth and always speaks truth.

sa: अशोकवनिका चापि महतीयं महादुमा। इमामधिगमिष्यामि नहीयं विचिता मया।५३ ।।
en: This is the Asoka wood, extensive and containing mighty trees. This I shall explore, as it has not yet been searched by me.

sa: बृहस्पतिस्ततः क्रुद्धः स्रुचमुद्यम्य वेगितः। आकाशं जन् स्रुचः पातै रोषादश्रूण्यवर्तयत्॥
en: At this, Brihaspati became angry. Taking up the ladle he hurled it violently at the sky, and began to shed tears in anger.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच सर्वमेतद्धि भविता मत्प्रसादात् तव द्विज। प्रतिभास्यति योगश्च येन युक्तो दिवौकसाम्॥ त्रयाणामपि लोकानां महत् कार्यं करिष्यसि।
en: (The deity replied), “O Brahmana, all this will happen to you through my favour. A Yoga will be manifest in you. Through its power you will perform a great act for the dwellers of heaven as also for the three worlds.

sa: ज्वलितां त्वमिमां लक्ष्मी भारती सर्वराजसु। जीवतो धृतराष्ट्रस्य दौरात्म्याद् भ्रंशयिष्यसि॥
en: Do not by your wicked deeds cause to break down this blazing prosperity of the Bharatas, among all kings while Dhritarashtra is alive.

sa: व्याक्रोशन् बान्धवानन्ये तत्र तत्र परंतप। क्रोशाद्भिर्दयितैरन्ये भयार्ता न निवतिरे।॥
en: Some warriors, O scorcher of foes, loudly called upon their kinsmen and friends. Some, called upon by crying kinsmen, returned stricken with fear,

sa: रणे पण्डितकश्चैनं त्रिभिर्बाणैः समार्पयत्। स तन्न ममृषे भीमः शत्रुभिर्वधमाहवे॥
en: Panditaka pierced Bhima with three shafts in that battle. But Bhima did not tolerate these wounds inflicted by his enemies in that battle.

sa: क्रौञ्चात् परो वामनको वामनादन्धकारकः। अन्धकारात् परो राजन् मैनाकः पर्वतोत्तमः॥
en: Next to Krauncha is Vamanaka, next to Vamanaka is Andhakaraka, next to Andhakaraka is that foremost of all mountains which is called Mainaka.

sa: निवातकवचान् युद्धे वासवेनापि दुर्जयान्। जितवान् समरे पार्थः पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: That the son of Pritha vanquished in battle the Nivatakavacha brothers difficult of vanquishment by Indra himself is indication enough of his velour.

sa: पृष्ठतो हनुमान् वीरो नलो नीलश्च वीर्यवान्। तारश्चैव महातेजा हरियूथपयूथपः॥
en: They were followed by the heroic Hanumān, the mighty Nala and Neela, and the highly powerful Tārā, the leader of the monkey herd.

sa: कथं वेषां तदा युद्धे धृतिरासीन्मुमूर्षताम्। शैनेयचरितं दृष्ट्वा यादृशं सव्यसाचिनः॥
en: How indeed did those dying wretches set their heart on fight, when Sini's grandson who is equal to Savyasachin himself appeared before them?

sa: ततस्ते राक्षसेन्द्रेण चोदिता मन्त्रिणः सुताः। निर्ययुर्भवनात् तस्मात् सप्त सप्तार्चिवर्चसः॥
en: Then ordered by the lord of Rākşasas, the sons of his counsellors, seven (in number) in splendour reseinbling fire, issued forth that mansion.

sa: मतमाज्ञाय राज्ञश्च भीमसेनेन माधव। संशमो बाहुवीर्यं च ख्यापितं माधवात्मनः॥
en: Bhimasena, having ascertained the wishes of the king, has dwelt on peace as well as on his own strength of arms, O Madhava.

sa: पानीयमन्तिके पश्य वृक्षांश्चाप्युदकाश्रितान्। एते हि भ्रातरः श्रान्तास्तव तात पिपासिताः॥
en: O affectionate one, as these your brothers are fatigued and thirsty, so see whether any water or trees growing by water-side, are near.”

sa: सौतिरुवाच जनमेजयः पारिक्षितः सह भ्रातृभिः भ्रातृभिः कुरुक्षेत्रे दीर्घसत्रमुपास्ते। तस्य भ्रातरस्त्रयः श्रुतसेन। उग्रसेनो भीमसेन इति। तेषु तत्सत्रमुपासीनेष्वागच्छत्सारमेयः॥
en: Sauti said: The son of Parikshit, Janamejaya, with his brothers, was attending his long sacrifice in the field of Kurukshetra. His brothers were three, namely-Shrutasena, Ugrasena and Bhimasena. When they were sitting at the sacrifice, there came the son of Sarama.

sa: विक्रमेण मही प्राप्ता भरतेन महात्मना। विक्रमेण च लोकांस्त्रीञ्जितवान् पाकशासनः॥
en: The whole earth was acquired by the illustrious Bharata by his prowess. Indra has obtained the sovereignty of three worlds by prowess alone.

sa: विदुरद्रोणभीष्माणां तथान्येषां हितैषिणाम्। अकृत्वा वचनं पथ्यं क्षयं गच्छन्ति कौरवाः॥
en: Disregarding the salutary advice offered by well-wishing friends like Bhishma, Drona, Vidura and others, the descendants of the Kuru race are reaping destruction.

sa: अदहद् देवसैन्यानि वेपमानानि भूतले। ते प्रदीप्तशिरोदेहाः प्रदीप्तायुधवानहाः॥ प्रच्युताः सहसा भान्ति व्यस्तास्तारागणा इव। दह्यमानाः प्रपन्नास्ते शरणं पावकात्मजम्॥ देवा वलाधरं त्यक्त्वा ततः शान्तिमुपागताः। त्यक्तो देवैस्ततः स्कन्दे वलां शक्रो न्यपातयत्॥
en: Those flames made the celestial army struggle on the ground. Their heads, their bodies, their arms and their riding animals were all burnt in that conflagration; they all appeared like stars displaced from their proper spheres. Thus afflicted they all abandoned the wielder of thunder and took protection of the son of Agni. Thus they secured peace. Being thus forsaken by the celestial, Indra hurled his thunder on Skanda.

sa: कस्माच्चिद् दानयोगाद्धि सत्यमेव विशिष्यते। सत्यवाक्याच्च राजेन्द्र किंचिद् दानं विशिष्यते॥
en: Sometimes truthfulness is considered superior to some charitable acts. And, O king of kings, sometimes charity is deemed more praiseworthy than true speech.

sa: तबुध्वा भृशसंतप्तो देवराज: शतक्रतुः। जगाम शरणं तत्र कश्यपं संशितव्रतम्॥
en: The Lord of the celestials Shatakratu, becoming very much alarmed, went to ask the protection of the great ascetic, the selfcontrolled Rishi Kashyapa.

sa: ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं तस्मात् सप्तजनाश्रमात्। दद्दशुस्तां दुराधर्षां किष्किन्धां वालिपालिताम्॥
en: And wending a distant way from that hermitage of the seven great ones, they beheld Kişkindhä, hard to conquer and occupied by Vali.

sa: नान्यत्र युद्धाच्छ्रेयोऽस्ति तथाऽऽत्मा प्रणिधीयताम्॥१७ आच्छिन्ने गोधनेऽस्माकमपि देवेन वज्रिणा। यमेन वापि संग्रामे को हास्तिनपुरं व्रजेत्॥ शरैरेभिः प्रणुनानां भग्नानां गहने वने। को हि जीवेत् पदातीनां भवेदश्वेषु संशयः॥ दुर्योधनवचः श्रुत्वा राधेयस्त्वब्रवीद् वचः। आचार्य पृष्ठतः कृत्वा तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम्॥
en: There is no other help but fighting now. Make up your minds, therefore, Even, for seizing these precious kine, we have got to fight with the Divine holder of thunder-bolt or with Yama. Who is there that will be able to go to Hastinapur? Pierced by my shafts, when running away from the battle field through the woods, who amongst the infantry shall be able to escape with his life, while that of the cavalry is so doubtful? Keeping, the preceptor behind, do you make all arrangements.

sa: उद्यतेषुमथो दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणं क्षत्रबन्धुवत्। यो हन्यात् समरे क्रुद्धं युध्यन्तमपलायिनम्॥
en: One, who seeing a Brahmana, ready to fight like a friend of the Kshatriyas, wrathfully slays him who flies not from the fled,

sa: अथैवमुक्त उत्तङ्कः स्मृत्वोवाचास्ति खलु मयोत्थितेनोपस्पृष्टं गच्छता चेति। तं पौष्यः प्रत्युवाच एष ते व्यतिक्रमो नोत्थितेनोपस्पृष्टं भवतीति शीघ्रं गच्छता चेति॥
en: Uttanka, thus addressed, thought for a while and then replied, “ Yes, it is so. As I was in a hurry, I performed my ablutions when I was walking." Paushya said, "This is a transgression. Ablutions cannot properly be performed standing or walking in a hurry.”

sa: समानः प्रचचाराथ उदानस्तमुवाच ह। श्रेष्ठाऽहमस्मि सर्वेषां श्रूयतां येन हेतुना॥
en: Then Samana began to inovc about. To him Udana said, I am the foremost of all the vital airs. Listen, for what reason.

sa: तस्याभिगमनप्राप्ती हस्तौ दत्तौ विवस्वता। तेनापि दक्षिणो हस्तो दत्तः प्रत्यर्चितार्थिना॥
en: As soon as he came near the Sun extended his two hands. For honouring the Sun in return, he also extended his right-hand.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो धर्मश्च शक्रश्च मरुतश्चाश्विनावपि। देवा देवर्षयश्चैव रथमारोप्य पाण्डवम्॥ प्रययुः स्वैर्विमानैस्ते सिद्धाः कामविहारिणः। सर्वे विरजसः पुण्या: पुण्यवाग्बुद्धिकर्मिणः॥
en: Vaishampayana said, Then Dharma and Shakra, and the Maruts, and the Ashvins and other deities and the celestial Rishis, causing Yudhishthira to ascend on a car, went to the celestial region. Those beings crowned with success and capable of going everywhere at will,orode their respective cars.

sa: युधिष्ठिरोधर्मराजः शापात् त्वां मोक्षयिष्यति। अभिमानस्य घोरस्य पापस्य च नराधिप॥
en: Yudhishthira, the best of the virtuous will liberate you from this curse. And O Monarch, when this horrible sin of pride (in you).

sa: स राजभवनप्रख्यात् तस्माद् रामनिवेशनात्। निर्गत्य ददृशे मार्ग वसिष्ठो जनसंवृतम्॥
en: (On the other hand) Vasistha, issuing from the palace of Rāma like to the king's palace itself, found the street filled with people.

sa: अथ दक्षिणादूरोरुत्कृत्य स्वमांसपेशीं तुलया धारयत्। गुरुतर एव कपोत आसीत्॥
en: Thereupon he cut off a piece of flesh from his right thigh and weighed it with the pigeon, but the pigeon weighed heavier.

sa: कार्यमेतन्महद् ब्रह्मन् काशिकन्यामनोगतम्। गमिष्यामि स्वयं तत्र कन्यामादाय यत्र सः॥
en: This work, aimed at by the princess of Kashis, is indeed great, Taking this lady, I shall go myself there where he is.

sa: युधिष्ठिरोऽहमस्मीति वाक्यमुक्त्वाग्रतः स्थितः। विदुरस्य श्रवे राजा तं च प्रत्यभ्यपूजयत्॥
en: Standing before him, Yudhishthira addressed him saying, 'I am Yudhishthira.' Indeed, adoring Vidura properly., Yudhishthira said these words in the hearing of Vidura.

sa: दूरादालक्षितः क्षत्ता तत्राख्यातो महीपतेः। निवर्तमानः सहसा राजन् दृष्ट्वाऽऽश्रमं प्रति॥
en: When Kshatta, was seen from a distance, the fact was communicated to Yudhishthira. Vidura suddenly stopped, O king, loO king towards the retreat.

sa: ददौ तेभ्यः सहस्राणि गवां प्रत्येकशः पुनः। पुण्याहघोषस्तत्रासीद दिवस्पृगिव भारत॥
en: He also gave them each one thousand kine. O descendant of Bharata, their cry of “What an auspicious day" rose to the sky.

sa: तावकांस्तव पुत्रांश्च योधयन्ति प्रहृष्टवत्। सेनापतिस्तु समरे प्राह सेनां महारथः॥
en: Cheerfully fought on with your troops and your sons. Then that mighty car-warrior the commander of the Pandava host addressing his troops said.

sa: इत्येवं विलपन दीनः प्रस्विनमुखपङ्कजः। पादावप्राप्य रामस्य पपात भरतो रुदन्॥
en: Thus lamenting in woeful guise, with the lotus of his countenance covered with sweat, Bharata coming at Rāma's feet, fell at them bewailing.

sa: पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनंजयः। पौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्ख भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः॥
en: Hrishikesha (Krishna) blew the conch called Panchajanya and Dhananjaya Devadatta. That doer of fearful deeds, Vrikodara (Bhima) blew his huge conch, called Paundra.

sa: तौ प्रविष्टौ महासेनां बलवन्तौ मनस्विनौ। आर्छतां बहुसंरब्धौ केशाकेशि रथारथिः॥
en: These two mighty car-warriors entered into the huge army of Trigartas. And having entered into the great army those two intelligent and powerful.

sa: प्राणानुत्स्रष्टुमिच्छामि तत्रानुज्ञातुमर्हथ। सत्येषु यतितव्यं वः सत्यं हि परमं बलम्॥
en: I wish to renounce my life. You should give me leave. You should strive for attaching to truth. Truth forms the highest power.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा दारुकमिदं वाक्यमाह धनञ्जयः। अमात्यान् वृष्णिवीराणां द्रष्टुमिच्छामि मा चिरम्।।६।
en: Having said so to his uncle, Arjuna, next addressed Daruka, saying, I wish to see forthwith the chief officers of the Vrishni heroes.

sa: राजा प्रजानां हृदयं गरीये गतिः प्रतिष्ठा सुखमुत्तमं च। समाश्रिता लोकमिमं परं च जयन्ति सम्यक् पुरुषा नरेन्द्र॥
en: The king is the heart of his people; he is their great refuge; he is their glory; and he is their greatest happiness. Those men, O king, who are attached to the king, can conquer both this and the next world.

sa: तमरिघ्नं कृतात्मानं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम्। लक्ष्मणं च धनुष्पाणिं लङ्काद्वारमुपागतम्॥
en: Soon shall you behold that destroyer of foes, Rāghava of subdued soul, and the bow-bearing Laksmana also, come to the gate of Lanka.

sa: यदस्य बहुधा रूपं भूतभव्यभवस्थितम्। स्थावरं जङ्गमं चैवं बहुरूपस्ततः स्मृतः॥
en: As in the past, the present and the future, the god has many forms, both mobile and immobile, he is truly called Vahurupa.

sa: नागलोके च यद् वृत्तं गुणदोषमशेषतः। तच्च सर्वमशेषेण कथयामास पाण्डवः॥
en: The Pandava (Bhima) told them in detail all about the lucky and unlucky incidents that befell him in the region of the Nagas.

sa: ततः प्राग्ज्योतिषो राजा प्रहसन्निव भारत। तस्याश्वांश्चतुरः संख्ये पातयामास सायकैः॥
en: Thereupon the king of the Pragjyotishas, in that combat, as if smiling, dispatched, O Bharata, to death the four horses of the Rakshasas.

sa: ततो मायां समांस्थाय शिलावर्षेण राघवौ। अवाकिरत् सुमहतां ततश्चक्रोध राघवः॥
en: And then by help of illusion, she began to pour upon them a mighty shower of crags. And thereat Raghu's descendant was wroth.

sa: तां तथा ब्रुवतस्तस्य भूमिपस्य महात्मनः। प्रभाता शर्वरी पुण्या चन्द्रनक्षत्रमालिनी॥
en: As the high-souled ruler of earth was speaking thus to her, the night engarlanded with the moon and stars.was succeeded by the morning.

sa: भिद्यमानस्ततो गर्भो वज्रेण शतपर्वणा। रुरोद सुस्वरं राम ततो दितिरबुध्यत॥
en: And the embryo being pierced by the thunderbold of an hundred knots, cried at the top of its voice, and thereat Diti awoke.

sa: किं मां वक्ष्यन्ति राजानो नानादिग्भ्यः समागताः॥ बालो बतायमैक्ष्वाकश्चिरं राज्यमकारयत्।
en: And what will the monarchs coming from various quarters say concerning me, “Alas! how has this puerile descendant of Ikşvāku reigned so long?"

sa: तस्य शृङ्ग दिवस्पर्श काञ्चनं चित्रपादपम्॥ सर्वमाशु विचेतव्यं कपिभिः कामरूपिभिः।
en: The monkeys, capable of wearing shapes at will, should swiftly search its golden summit towering to the sky and filled with graceful trees.

sa: स प्रहस्य महारौद्रः स्थित्वाजृम्भत राक्षसः। जृम्भमाणस्य ते वाणाः कायान्निष्पेतुराशुगाः॥
en: Stationing himself at a spot, the Rākşasa, laughing terribly, yawned, and as he yawned the flest-coursing shafts fell off from his person, a

sa: अथ चीराणि कैकेयी स्वयमाहृत्य राघवम्। उवाच परिधत्स्वेति जनौघे निरपत्रपा॥
en: Thereupon Kaikeyi herself brought a bark dress and that shameless one said to Rāghava in the presence of all, “Do you wear this.”

sa: ब्रूयाश्चापि महाराजं भरतं क्षिप्रमानय। आगतश्चापि भरतः स्थाप्यो नृपमते पदे॥
en: Do you also tell the king, 'Do you speedily bring Bharata; and when Bharata has come, let him be the invested with royalty.

sa: बलं दृष्ट्वा भरतो गुरुसंनिधौ। रथं मे त्वरयस्वेति सुमन्त्रं पार्श्वऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing those force marshalled, Bharata staying near his preceptor, said to Sumantra who was at his side, “Do you speedily bring my car”

sa: प्रहृष्टस्त्वभवद् रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महारथः। मैथिल्याः सत्क्रियां दृष्ट्वा मानुषेषु सुदुर्लभाम्॥
en: Thereupon, witnessing the honour that had been accorded to Maithili, rare among men, Rāma became well pleased, as also that mighty car-warrior, Laksmana.

sa: न्यवेदयत् ततः सर्वं सीता रामाय मैथिली। प्रीतिदानं तपस्विन्या वसनाभरणस्रजाम्॥
en: Then Mithila's daughter, Sita, related to Rama all about her having been affectionately presented by the ascetic with attire, ornaments and the garland.

sa: तस्याः स्तनान्तराद् भ्रष्टो हारस्ताराधिपद्युतिः। वैदेह्या निपतन् भाति गङ्गेव गगनच्युता॥
en: And the chain of the splendour of the moon, removed from Vaidehi's breast, falling down, shone like the Gangā dropping from the sky.

sa: एतावद् वानरैः शक्यं गन्तुं वानरपुङ्गवाः। अभास्करममर्यादं न जानीमस्ततः परम्॥
en: You foremost of monkeys, the monkeys are able to proceed thus far. Beyond this, of what is sunless and boundless I know nothing.

sa: राजापि तौ महातेजाः सस्मार प्रोषितौ सुतौ। उभौ भरतशत्रुघ्नौ महेन्द्रवरुणोपमौ॥
en: And the puissant king also on his pare remembered his sons away from home, Bharata and Śatrughna, resembling the mighty Indra and Varuna.

sa: लब्धशब्देन कौसल्ये कुमारेण धनुष्मता। कुमारः शब्दवेधीति मया पापमिदं कृतम्॥
en: Having, O Kausalyā, earned the expression, 'The Prince can pierce his aim by sound alone,', I, a prince and bowman, did this offence.

sa: ततो रुदन्त्यो विवशा विलप्य च पुनः पुनः। यानेभ्यः सरयूतीरमवतेरुपाङ्गनाः॥
en: Weeping again and again with their sense lost, the wives of the king alighted from the car on the banks of the Sarayu.

sa: अथ राजा दशरथस्तेषां दारक्रियां प्रति॥ चिन्तयामास धर्मात्मा सोपाध्यायः सबान्धवः। तस्य चिन्तयमानस्य मन्त्रिमध्ये महात्मनः॥ अभ्यागच्छन्महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः।
en: Once upon a time, when the virtuous king Dasaratha, surrounded by his priests and friends, was reflecting about the nuptials of his sons, to that high-souled one engaged in thought in the midst of his counsellors came the mighty ascetic Visvamitra.

sa: तां परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यां विसंज्ञामिव दुःखिताम्। उवाच वचनं रामः परिविश्वासयंस्तदा॥
en: Finding her almost insensible with sorrow, Rāma flung his arms round her and reviving her (with consolation) spoke the following words to her.

sa: अन्तरिक्षे च वागुक्ता प्रतिमामानुषि किल। एवमेतन्नरपते धर्मेण तनया तव॥
en: Then there were uttered words in the welkin, resembling those of a human being,! 'O king, in all righteousness, this is your daughter'.

sa: रुमाद्वितीयं सुग्रीवं नारीमध्यगतं स्थितम्। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धः सतारं शंशिनं यथा॥
en: And the wrathful Lakşmaņa spoke to Sugrīva stationed among women, having Umā for his second, and resembling the moon with the stars, saying.

sa: तरुणी रूपसम्पन्ना सर्वाभरणभूषिता। दृष्ट्वा तत्र मया नारी तयोर्मध्ये सुमध्यमा॥
en: And between them I saw there a youthful female furnished with grace, and having a dainty waist; adorned with every kind of ornament.

sa: भ्रातृत्वमार्यभावश्च धर्मश्चानेन रक्षितः। मया क्रोधश्च कामश्च कपित्वं च प्रदर्शितम्॥
en: He all along maintained his fraternal feelings, his honesty and piety; but (woe to me) I have displayed my wrath, passion and monkey-hood.

sa: सा वस्त्रमङ्गरागं च भूषणानि स्रजस्तथा। मैथिली प्रतिजग्राह प्रीतिदानमनुत्तमम्॥ प्रतिगृह्य च तत् सीता प्रीतिदानं यशस्विनी। श्लिष्टाञ्जलिपुटा धीरा समुपास्त तपोधनाम्॥
en: Thereupon Mithila's daughter accepted those things presented to her out of love, viz., the apparel, the paint, the ornaments and the garland. Having accepted those accepted those presents conferred on her from love, that illustrious one, Sītā, quietly sat beside the female ascetic with joined hands.

sa: दृष्ट्वा निपतितं भूमौ रावणं भग्नवाहनम्। साधु साध्विति भूतानि गृध्रराजमपूजयन्॥
en: Beholding Rāvaņa fallen on the ground and of broken conveyance, all creatures praised the king of vultures again and again and worshipped him.

sa: एवंविधाश्च प्रवराः स्त्रियो भर्तृदृढव्रताः। देवलोके महीयन्ते पुण्येन स्वेन कर्मणा॥
en: And prime women of this sort, firm in their husbands, are highly respected in the celestial regions by virtue of their pious acts.

sa: यद्यपि त्वं क्षितितलाद् गगनं चोत्पतिष्यसि। पितृवंशचरित्रज्ञः सोऽन्यथा न करिष्यति॥
en: Even if you leaving the earth fly to the air, that one cognizant of the character of his ancestry, will never act otherwise.

sa: आभिषेचनिकं सर्वमिदमादाय राघव। प्रतीक्षते त्वां स्वजनः श्रेणयश्च नृपात्मज ॥
en: O Raghava, having procured all these necessaries for the installation, the counsellor and othe, as well as the citizens wait, О king's son.

sa: सीतातृतीयः काकुत्स्थः परिश्रान्तः सुखोचितः। भरद्वाजाश्रमे रम्ये तां रात्रिमवसत् सुखम्॥
en: And with Sītā for the third, Kåkutstha brought up in luxury, being fatigued, pleasantly spent that night at the romantic hermitage of Bharadvāja.

sa: युज्यतां महती सेना चतुरङ्गमहाबला। आनयिष्याम्यहं ज्येष्ठं भ्रातरं राघवं वनात्॥
en: Do you array the grand and mighty my consisting of fourfold forces. I will bring back from the forest my eldest brother Rāghava.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धः सहस्राक्षः पर्वतानां शतक्रतुः। पक्षांश्चिच्छेद वज्रेण ततः शतसहस्रशः॥
en: Highly enraged therefore, the thousand-eyed Deity, the performer of hundred sacrifices, hundred with his thunderbolt, the wings of hundreds and thousands of them.

sa: मनुः प्रजापतिः पूर्वमिक्ष्वाकुश्च मनोः सुतः। तमिक्ष्वाकुमयोध्यायां राजानं विद्धि पूर्वकम्॥
en: This Manu is otherwise called Prajäpati; and Ikşvāku is Manu's son. And this Ikşvāku you must understand, was the first king of Ayodhyā.

sa: तद्वृत्तं नृपतिः श्रुत्वा दूतश्रेष्ठैर्महाजवैः। आज्ञया तु नरेन्द्रस्य आजगाम कुशध्वजः॥
en: And hearing the tidings conveyed by those foremost of envoys endowed with great fleetness, Kusadhvaja set out at the mandate of the monarch.

sa: ऋषयस्तत्र बहवो विहृत्य शरदां शतम्। तपसा दिवमारूढाः कपालशिरसा सह॥
en: There innumerable saints with the hair of their heads rendered white like skulls, having spent hundreds of years, have through austerities ascended heaven.

sa: तदज्ञानान्महत्पापं कृत्वा संकुलितेन्द्रियः। एकस्त्वचिन्तयं बुद्ध्या कथं नु सुकृतं भवेत्॥
en: Having unwittingly committed that great sin, I, with my senses oppressed through grief, thought within myself as to how I could mend it.

sa: ॐ तपः स्वाध्यायनिरतं तपस्वी वाग्विदां वरम्। नारदं परिपप्रच्छ वाल्मीकिर्मुनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: The ascetic Vālmīki asked Nārada, the best of sages and foremost of those conversant with words, ever engaged in austerities and Vedic studies.

sa: मन्त्रवच्च यथान्यायं यज्ञोऽसौ सम्प्रवर्तते। आकाशे च महाञ्छब्दः प्रादुरासीद् भयानकः॥
en: And as reciting mantras, they were about to duly engage in that sacrifice, there arose a mighty and dreadful uproar in the sky.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं प्राप्तकालं हितं तदा। उवाचार्तिसमापनो विक्रमे कृतनिश्चयः॥
en: Hearing those words Laksmana, sore, distressed and determined to display his valour, addressed Rāma with words worthy of being said on that occasion.

sa: धनू रुद्रस्तु संक्रुद्धो विदेहेषु महायशाः॥ देवरातस्य राजर्षेर्ददौ हस्ते ससायकम्।
en: The enraged Rudra of high fame made over the bow along with its shafts to the hands of the Rajarsi, Devarata of Videha.

sa: गुणान् गुणवतो देव देवकल्पस्य धीमतः। प्रियानानन्दनान् कृत्स्नान् प्रवक्ष्यामोऽद्य ताञ्छृणु॥
en: To-day we will recount to you in detail the merits making even enemies happy of the meritorious and intelligent (Rāma) resembling a celestial.

sa: तद् व्यतीतस्य ते धर्मात् कामवृत्तस्य वानर। भ्रातृभाभिमर्शेऽस्मिन् दण्डोऽयं प्रतिपादितः॥
en: O monkey, you had thus violated the path of virtue. And thus I have punished you who have ravished your elder brother's spouse.

sa: न ते शतशलाकेन जलफेननिभेन च। आवृतं वदनं वल्गु च्छत्रेणाभिविराजते॥
en: Why has not your charming face been placed under the shade of an umbrella having hundred ribs and white as a watery foam?

sa: वैदेहि रमसे कच्चिच्चित्रकूटे मया सह। पश्यन्ती विविधान् भावान् मनोवाक्वायसंमतान्॥
en: O daughter of Videha, are you being pleased on viewing along with me on Citrakuța, various objects grateful to mind, speech and body?

sa: सर्वथा क्रियतां यत्नः सीतामधिगमिष्यथ ॥ पक्षलाभो ममायं वः सिद्धिप्रत्ययकारकः।
en: Do you strive every way. You shall meet with Sītā. And my getting (back) my wings inspires (us) with confidence as to success.

sa: उभावपि च शोकार्तावनाथौ कृपणौ वने। क्षिप्रमेव गमिष्यावस्त्वया हीनौ यमक्षयम्॥
en: Distressed with grief and rendered miserable in the forest, both of us deprived of you shall soon repair to the abode of Yama.

sa: अवरुह्य ततो भूमिं श्रान्ता विगतचेतसः। स्थिता मुहूर्तं तत्राथ वृक्षमूलमुपाश्रिताः॥
en: And having descended to the earth, the monkeys, bewildered, and losing their consciousness, rested for a while at the foot of a tree.

sa: अन्तश्चरसि भूतानां सर्वेषां सुरसत्तम। प्रभावज्ञाश्च ते सर्वाः किमर्थमवमन्यसे ॥
en: You range the hearts of all creatures, O foremost of celestials, and we also know your influence. Wherefore, then, do you dishonour us?

sa: अस्मिंस्तु पुरुषव्याघ्र काले दुःखसमन्वितः। तपश्चरित धर्मात्मा त्वद्भक्त्या भरतः पुरे॥
en: O foremost of men, at this season, influenced by regard for you, Bharata undergoing affliction of spirit, is performing mortification's in the city.

sa: स पिता मम काकुत्स्थ गाधिः परमधार्मिकः। कुशवंशप्रसूतोऽस्मि कौशिको रघुनन्दन॥
en: O Kākutstha, even that highly pious Gadhi is my sire. And, O descendant of Raghu, I, called Kausika, am sprung from Kusa's line.

sa: कच्चिद् दर्शयसे नित्यं मानुषाणां विभूषितम्। उत्थायोत्थाय पूर्वाह्ने राजपुत्र महापथे॥
en: And do you show yourself daily in the court, well robed? And rising in the morning, do you show yourself in the high-ways?

sa: एवं स विलपन् रामः सीताहरणकर्षितः। दीनः शोकसमाविष्टो मुहूर्तं विह्वलोऽभवत्॥
en: Thus bewailing Rāma, racked with sorrow consequent on Sītā being carried away, became poorly and afflicted with grief and swooned away for sometime.

sa: ते मुहूर्तं समाश्वस्ताः किंचिद्भग्नपरिश्रमाः। पुनरेवोद्यताः कृत्स्नां मार्गितुं दक्षिणां दिशम्॥
en: And their fatigue having gone off a little, the monkeys, having been refreshed for a while, again prepared to explore the whole South.

sa: मृदुसूर्याः सुनीहाराः पटुशीताः समाहिताः। शून्यारण्या हिमध्वस्ता दिवसा भान्ति साम्प्रतम्॥
en: The days now have mild suns, are covered with dew severely cold, with the forests remaining idle, and the lotuses destroyed by frost.

sa: निवर्तितेऽतीव बलात् सुहृद्धर्मेण राजनि। नैव ते संन्यवर्तन्त रामस्यानुगता रथम्॥
en: Even when the king in the interests of his son had with much ado restrained himself, these, following Răma's car, did not desist.

sa: धर्मलोपो महांस्तावत् कृते ह्यप्रतिकुर्वतः। अर्थलोपश्च मित्रस्य नाशे गुणवतो महान्॥
en: He who does not return the services of his benefactor, loseth piety. He who who loseth friendship with a qualified friend, loseth wealth.

sa: हृदये मे वनव्याघ्र शुभमाविर्भविष्यति। तदागच्छ गमिष्यावः पम्पां तां प्रियदर्शनाम्॥
en: Me-thinks, O best of men, auspiciousness shall soon appear to us; do you come, therefore, we shall proceed towards the picturesque lake Pampā.

sa: उग्रेण तपसा युक्तां ददौ शैलवरः सुताम्। रुद्रायाप्रतिरूपाय उमां लोकनमस्कृताम्॥
en: And that best of mountains bestowed upon Rudra of unequalled form his daughter Uma, furnished with fiery asceticism and worshipped of the worlds.

sa: तानुवाच ततः प्राप्तान् वाचार्कसदृशप्रभः॥ उपस्थापयत क्षिप्रं शिबिकां मम वानराः।
en: To them, who had presented themselves, said the king, of splendour resembling that of the Sun, Do, you monkeys, bring hither a car.8

sa: एवमुक्तः सुरैः सर्वैश्चिन्तयित्वा ततोऽब्रवीत्। हन्तायं विदितस्तस्य वधोपायो दुरात्मनः॥ तेन गन्धर्वयक्षाणां देवतानां च रक्षसाम्। अवध्योऽस्मीति वागुक्ता तथेत्युक्तं च तन्मया॥
en: Thus addressed by the deities in a body, he said, Alas! I have, however, decided on the means of destroying that wicked-souled one. He had asked, 'May I be incapable of being slain by Gandharvas, and Yaksas, and gods, and Raksasas!,-whereat I said, 'Be it so!'

sa: अश्मभिः परिभिन्नाङ्गः पादपैराहतो भृशम्। रामबाणेन चाक्रान्तो जीवितान्ते मुमोह सः॥
en: Having his limbs dissevered by stones, being struck with trees and wounded by Rama's shaft, he became senseless at the approach of death.

sa: परस्परेण रहिता अन्योन्यस्याविदूरतः। गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गन्धमादनः॥ मैन्दश्च द्विविदश्चैव हनूमान् जाम्बवानपि। अङ्गदो युवराजश्च तारश्च वनगोचरः॥ गिरिजालावृतान् देशान् मार्गित्वा दक्षिणां दिशम्। विचिन्वन्तस्ततस्तत्र ददृशुर्विवृतं बिलम्॥ दुर्गमृक्षबिलं नाम दानवेनाभिरक्षितम्। क्षुत्पिपासापरीतास्तु श्रान्तास्तु सलिलार्थिनः॥ अवकीर्णं लतावृक्षैर्ददृशशुस्ते महाबिलम्। तत्र क्रौञ्चश्च हंसाश्च सारसाश्चापि निष्क्रमन्॥ जलार्दाश्चकवाकाश्च रक्ताङ्गाः पद्मरेणुभिः।
en: And each apart remaining at no great distance from the others, Gaja, Gavākha and Gavaya, Sarabha, Gandhamādana, Mainda, Dwivida, and Hanumān, Jambavān, the youthful prince Angada, and Tārā, remaining in sight of the wood, after having searched the South-lands covered with mountain ranges, were searching (about), when they espied an unenclosed cavity, difficult of entry, named Věkşavila, guarded by a Dānava. And tried by hunger and thirst, worn out with fatigue, seeking for water, they found that cavity surrounded by trees and plants. And, with their bodies drenched and reddened with lotus dust, Kraunchas and swans and cranes and Chakravākas, came out of the cavity.

sa: शरधारासमूहान् स महामेघ इवोत्सृजन्। व्यसृजत् सदृशं नादं जलार्द्रस्येव दुन्दुभेः॥
en: And as a mighty cloud pours down shower, (Trisirā) discharging vollies of shafts, uttered a roar resembling the sound of a wet kettledrum.

sa: क्षिप्रान् वृक्षान् समाविध्य विपुलाश्च तथा शिला:। वाली वज्रसमैर्बाणैर्वज्रेणेव निपातितः॥
en: He was killed by (Rāma's) shafts, resembling thunderbolts as if clapped by thunder itself, having bored trees and big stones (hurled by Vali).

sa: तदिदं वचनं राज्ञः पुनर्बाल्यमुपेयुषः। पुत्रः को हृदये कुर्याद् राजवृत्तमनुस्मरन्।७।।
en: What son, remembering his father's conduct, shall carry in his heart these words of the king, who has again gone back to childhood?

sa: मा स्म सीमन्तिनी काचिज्जनयेत् पुत्रमीदृशम्। सौमित्रे योऽहमम्बाया दद्मि शोकमनन्तकम्॥
en: Let on woman, O son of Sumitrā, gibe birth to a son like me who have imparted such infinite pain to my mother.

sa: पुत्रद्वयविहीनं च स्नुषया च विवर्जितम्। अपश्यद् भवनं राजा नष्टचन्द्रमिवाम्बरम्॥
en: The king surveyed the mansion deprived of his two sons as well as his daughter-in-law, like to the welkin deprived of the Moon.

sa: तत्र गत्वाऽऽश्रमपदं कृत्वा सौमित्रिणा सह। रमस्व त्वं पितुर्वाक्यं यथोक्तमनुपालयन्॥
en: Repairing thither, do you, rearing an asylum, pass your time pleasantly in company with Sumitrā's son, duly doing the mandate of your sire.

sa: कच्चिन्न सर्वे कर्मान्ताः प्रत्यक्षास्तेऽविशङ्कया। सर्वे वा पुनरुत्सृष्टा मध्यमेवात्र कारणम्॥
en: And do your servants boldly present themselves before you; or do they all keep away? A middle course contributes to their good fortune.

sa: परिक्षिप्ता समुद्रेण लङ्केयं शतयोजना। नेयं धर्षयितुं शक्या सेन्ट्रैरपि सुरासुरैः॥
en: This Larkă measuring an hundred Yojanas girt round by the ocean, is incapable of being harassed by the celestials themselves headed by Indra.

sa: ऋषिस्तु दृष्ट्वा मां तुष्टः प्रविष्टश्चाश्रमं पुनः। मुहूर्तमात्रानिर्गम्य ततः कार्यमपृच्छत॥
en: The saint was glad on seeing me. Then reentering his asylum for a short space, he came out and enquired for my mission.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु पुरुषव्याघ्र निष्क्रामति कृताञ्जलौ। आर्तशब्दो महान् जज्ञे स्त्रीणामन्तःपुरे तदा॥
en: There arose a great uproar of cry in the apartment of the females, when that best of men went out with clasped hands.

sa: जाबालेस्तु वचः श्रुत्वा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः। उवाच परया सूक्त्या बुद्ध्याविप्रतिपत्रया।॥
en: Hearing Jāvāli's words, Rāma having truth for prowess, by help of an exceedingly subtle intellect uninfluenced (under the exhortations of that sage), said.

sa: एष च प्रकृतिस्थोऽहमनुनीतस्तया सखे। दुर्लभो हीदृशो बन्धुरस्मिन् काले विशेषतः॥
en: Solicited by you, I have, O friend, regained my natural tone of mind. Such a friend is rare, specially at such a time.

sa: वीर वानरलोकस्य सर्वशास्त्रविदां वर। तूष्णीमेकान्तमाश्रित्य हनूमन् किं न जल्पसि॥
en: O hero among the monkey-multitude, O be of those versed in all branches of learning, staying apart silent, why did you not speak?

sa: आश्चर्यमिति तस्यैतद् वचनं भावितात्मनः। राघवः प्रतिजग्राह सह भ्रात्रा महायशाः॥
en: (Hearing this), the illustrious Rāghava along with his brother declared the story narrated by that one of a pure heart to be wonderful.

sa: लब्धसंज्ञस्तु षड्रावाद् विवशो विह्वलनिव। वीक्षमाणो दिशः सर्वा नाभिजानामि किंचन॥
en: On regaining my senses after six nights, during which I was insensible, I looked around in bewilderment, but could not recognise anything whatever.

sa: चत्वारो वार्षिका मासा गता वर्षशतोपमाः। मम शोकाभितप्तस्य तथा सीतामपश्यतः॥
en: Stricken as I am with grief, these four months, the season of rains, appeared to me like a hundred year, not beholding Sītā.

sa: स तृणैरावृतं दुर्ग धरण्या विवरं महत्। प्रविवेशासुरो वेगादावामासाद्य विष्ठितौ॥
en: And the Asura, coming by a capacious and impregnable hole covered with grass (on the surface), entered it amain; and we remained there.

sa: एतौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ दीर्घकालमरिंदम ॥ मलदाश्च करूषाश्च मुदिता धनधान्यतः।
en: O repressor of foes, these two places, Maladā and Karuṣā, enjoyed prosperity for a long time and were blessed with corn and wealth.

sa: ततस्तस्मै द्विजेन्द्राय राममाता यशस्विनी। दक्षिणां प्रददौ काम्यां राघवं चेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then that renowned mother of Rāma, after conferring upon the Brāhmaṇa's dakșinas, in accordance with heir desires, accosted Rāghava with the following words.

sa: मन्थराया वचः श्रुत्वा शयनात्सा शुभानना। उत्तस्थौ हर्षसंपूर्णा चन्द्रलेखेव शारदी॥
en: Hearing Mantharā's words, that one of graceful countenance filled with delight, and looking like the autumnal moon light, rose up from her bed.

sa: ते सर्वे हृष्टमनसस्तस्य राज्ञो निवेशनम्॥ विविशुः पूजितास्तेन निषेदुश्च यथार्हतः।
en: And having been properly received by the monarch, they with glad hearts entered the royal residence, and sat them down according to precedence.

sa: इदं बहुशलाकं ते पूर्णचन्द्रमिवोदितम्। छत्रं सवालव्यजनं प्रतीच्छस्व मया धृतम्॥
en: I hold this. umbrella furnished with many ribs, resembling the moon risen; as well as this chowrī containing hair,—do you accept my service.

sa: राज्ञामृद्धिविशेषा हि दृश्यन्ते भुवि यादृशाः। तादृशैरिह कुर्वन्तु वानरा भर्तृसत्क्रियाम्॥
en: Let the monkeys perform the obsequies of our master with such grandeur as befits the riches of the kings on this earth, a

sa: विकुक्षेस्तु महातेजा बाणः पुत्रः प्रतापवान्। बाणस्य च महाबाहुरनरण्यो महातपाः॥
en: Vikukși had the powerful Bāņa possessed of exceeding energy for his son. Bāna had the mighty-armed Anaranya of high austerities for his son.

sa: शून्योऽयं शयनीयस्ते पर्यङ्को हेमभूषितः। न चायमिक्ष्वाकुजनः प्रहृष्टः प्रतिभाति मे॥
en: This sleeping bedstead of yours adorned with gold is empty. I do not see the race of Ikşvāku in their usual good spirits.

sa: ततस्त्वां देवि सुभगे क्षेमेण पुनरागता। यक्ष्ये प्रमुदिता गङ्गे सर्वकामसमृद्धिनी॥
en: Then, O worshipful one, O you of auspicious fortune, having returned safely, I will, O Gangā, worship you, you that crown every desire.

sa: अग्निर्वायुस्तथा धूमो मन्त्राश्चर्षिमुखच्युताः। उपस्पर्शनकाले तु पान्तु त्वां रघुनन्दन ॥
en: May fire, air, smoke and the Mantras uttered by the Rșis protect you, Oh descendant of Raghu, at the time of your bathing.

sa: सूचकश्च कदर्यश्च मित्रघ्नो गुरुतल्पगः। लोकं पापात्मनामेते गच्छन्ते नात्र संशयः॥
en: The villainous, the avaricious, those who kill their friends and elope with their preceptor's wives, do always visit the land of the vicious.

sa: सोमसूर्यौ च काकुत्स्थ शिववैश्रवणावपि ॥ वरुणश्चाग्निरिन्द्रश्च विजयं प्रदिशन्तु ते।
en: Oh! Kākutstha, may the moon, Sun, Siva, Vaisravana, (the god of wealth), Varuna, (the god of water), Agni and Indra grant you victory.

sa: रामं राज्ञो नियोगेन त्वरया प्रस्थितो ह्यहम्।।१६। पूज्या राज्ञो भवन्तश्च रामस्य तु विशेषतः। अयं पृच्छामि वचनात् सुखमायुष्मतामहम्॥ राज्ञः सम्प्रतिबुद्धस्य चानागमनकारणम्। इत्युक्त्वान्तःपुरद्वारमाजगाम पुराणवित्॥ सदा सक्तं च तद् वेश्म सुमन्त्रः प्रविवेश ह। तुष्टावास्य तदा वंशं प्रविश्य स विशाम्पतेः॥ शयनीयं नरेन्द्रस्य तदासाद्य व्यतिष्ठत। सोऽत्यासाद्य तु तद्वेश्म तिरस्करणिमन्तरा॥ आशीर्भिर्गुणयुक्ताभिरभितुष्टाव राघवम्।
en: With the king's permission I am going to bring Rāma speedily here. Worshipful you are all to the king and specially to Rāma, I shall with your words, ask the king of his sound sleep, and then of the reasons for his not coming here as yet though up from the bed. Saying thus, Sumantra, versed in legends, arrived at the gate of the royal seraglio. And he entered the palace with its open gates; and having entered the apartment of the lord of earth he went into his sleeping room, and placing himself behind a screen near at hand, addressed the descendant of Raghu thus, pleasing him with blessings fraught with good to him.

sa: स्थितोऽयमिति मत्वाहं प्रविष्टस्तु दुरासदम्। तं मे मार्गयतस्तत्र गतः संवत्सरस्तदा॥
en: This one is stationed here-thinking thus, I entered that inaccessible cave. And as I searched (for the Asura), one entire year passed away.

sa: पितृशुश्रूषया पुत्र मातृशुश्रूषया तथा। सत्येन च महाबाहो चिरं जीवाभिरक्षितः॥
en: Do you of mighty hands live forever, being protected by the truth and merit of your continual services to your father and mother.

sa: प्रतिज्ञातस्त्वया वीर दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम्। ऋषीणां रक्षणार्थाय वधः संयति रक्षसाम् ॥
en: You have, O hero, for the protection of the saints dwelling in the forest of Dandaka, Promised the slaughter of Rākṣasas in battle.

sa: ततः पुरस्तात् सहसा विनिःसृतो महीपतेभरगतान् विलोकयन्। नुपस्थितान् द्वारमुपेत्य विष्ठितान्॥
en: Having come out of the presence of the king suddenly, he saw the warders, various citizens and great personages sitting at the gate.

sa: इति तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ मन्त्रयित्वा मनस्विनौ। सीतामेवाग्रतः कृत्वा कालिन्दी जग्मतुर्नदीम्॥
en: Having thus conversed with each other, those foremost of men endowed with intelligence, place Sītā in their front, proceeded towards the rive Kalindi.

sa: तद् भवन्तो मतिश्रेष्ठा बलवन्तो मनस्विनः॥ प्रहिताः कपिराजेन देवैरपि दुरासदाः।
en: You, foremost in intelligence, strong, intellectual, and incapable of being overcome by the gods themselves, have been despatched by the monarch of monkeys.

sa: पितामहस्तु सुप्रीतस्तस्य यक्षपतेस्तदा। कन्यारत्नं ददौ राम ताटकां नाम नामतः॥
en: And, O Rāma, the Grand-sire endowed her with that lord of Yakşas, conferred upon him a gem of a daughter, by name Tāțakā.

sa: तेषु देवर्षिजुष्टेषु जितेषु तपसा मया। मत्प्रसादात् सभार्यस्त्वं विहरस्व सलक्ष्मणः॥
en: Do you, by my grace, in company with your wife and Lakşmaņa, dwell delightfully in those regions won by my asceticism, containing Devarsis.

sa: अयं केकयराजस्य पुत्रो वसति पुत्रक॥ त्वां नेतुमागतो वीरो युधाजिन्मातुलस्तव।
en: O son, this son of the king of the Kekayas your uncle, Yudhājit stay here, that hero, having come to take you over.

sa: देवदेवे गते तस्मिन् सोऽङ्गुष्टाग्रनिपीडिताम्। कृत्वा वसुमती राम वत्सरं समुपासत॥
en: When that god of gods had gone away, Bhagiratha, O Rāma, pressing the earth with his thumb, spent a year in adoring Siva.

sa: स तूष्णीमेव तच्छ्रुत्वा राजा विद्रुतमानसः। मूर्छितो न्यपतद् भूमौ रामशोकाभिपीडितः॥
en: Hearing them silently, the monarch with his mind exceedingly wrought, dropped down to the ground in a swoon, afflicted with grief for Rāma.

sa: लोकवृत्तमनुष्ठेयं कृतं वो बाष्पमोक्षणम्। न कालादुत्तरं किंचित् कर्म शक्यमुपासितुम्॥
en: You have satisfied the worldly practice with a profuse discharge of tears. It is not proper to delay the performance of appointed actions.

sa: तं तथा पतितं संख्ये गतार्चिषमिवानलम्। ययातिमिव पुण्यान्ते देवलोकादिह च्युतम्॥ आदित्यमिव कालेन युगान्ते भुवि पातितम्। महेन्द्रमिव दुर्धर्षमुपेन्द्रमिव दुःसहम्॥ महेन्द्रपुत्रं पतितं वालिनं हेममालिनम्। व्यूढोरस्कं महाबाहुं दीप्तास्यं हरिलोचनम् ॥ लक्ष्मणानुचरो रामो ददर्शोपससर्प च। तं तथा पतितं वीरं गतार्चिषमिवानलम्॥ बहुमान्य च तं वीरं वीक्षमाणं शनैरिव। उपयातौ महावीयौं भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: Beholding the broad-chested and mightyarmed Vali, Mahendra's son, wearing a golden garland and having a flaming countenance and yellow eyes, thus struck down to the earth, resembling a flameless fire in the field of battle, like to Yayāti, slipped from the abode of the celestials on the wane of his piety, like to a tree falling down to the earth at the time of Dissolution, hard to repress as Mahendra himself, incapable to withstand like Upendra, Rāma, followed by Lakşmaņa, approached and beheld him. And paying respects to that hero falling on the earth like to a flameless fire and eyeing him again and again those two highly powerful brothers, Rāma and Laksmana neared him.

sa: नन्वार्योऽपि च धर्मात्मात्वयि वृत्तिमनुत्तमाम्। वर्तते गुरुवृत्तिज्ञो यथा मातरि वर्तते॥
en: Surely the noble and virtuous Råma, well knowing his duties towards his superiors, regards you as highly as he does his own mother.

sa: ततः प्रतीतं प्लवतां वरिष्ठमेकान्तमाश्रित्य सुखोपविष्टम्। संचोदयामास हरिप्रवीरो हरिप्रवीरं हनुमन्तमेव॥
en: Then that heroic monkey ordered foremost of monkeys, the highly heroic monkey Hanuman who stood apart, convinced (of the wisdom of Jambavān decision).

sa: रामोऽपि चारयंश्चक्षुः सर्वतो रणपण्डितः॥ ददर्श खरसैन्यं तद् युद्धायाभिमुखो गतः।
en: And Rāma also versed in warfare, casting his eyes around, found the forces of Khara ready for fight. Another text:-The holder of Pinaka.

sa: एहि पश्य शरीराणि मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्। हतानां राक्षसैघोरैर्बहूनां बहुधा वने॥
en: Come and behold the bodies of innumerable ascetics of pure hearts that have in various ways been slaughtered by Rākşasas in the forest.

sa: सं गत्वा दूरमध्वानं नदीस्तीत्वा॑ बहूदकाः। ददर्श विमलं शैलं महामेरुमिवोत्रतम्॥
en: And having proceeded far, and crossed many a stream of copious waters, Rāma saw a holy peak towering high like the mighty Meru.

sa: त्वामासाद्य महात्मानं धर्मज्ञं धर्मवत्सलम्। अर्थित्वान्नाथ वक्ष्यामस्तच्च नः क्षन्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: O lord, it behoves you cognizant of virtue and attached to it, to forgive us for what we as suiters say to you.

sa: तंत्र लङ्कां समासाद्य मुरीं रावणपालिताम्। ददर्श सीतां ध्यायन्तीमशोकवनिकां गताम्॥
en: Thereby arriving at the city of Lankā, ruled by Rāvana, he found Sītā in the midst of an Asoka garden, absorbed in thought.

sa: अपि तां मद्वियोगाच्च सौकुमार्याच्च भामिनीम्। सूदूरं पीडयेत् कामः शरद्गुणनिरन्तरः॥
en: Forsooth shall Cupid excited by the approach of the autumn, distress her the more on account of my separation and her personal charms.

sa: तथा डलर्कस्तेजस्वी ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे। याचमाने स्वके नेत्रे उद्धृत्याविमना ददौ॥
en: In the same manner, Alarka, being asked, plucked out his eyes readily and bestowed them on a certain Brāhmana versed in the Vedas.

sa: मुरजपणवमेघघोषवद् दशरथवेश्म बभूव यत् पुरा। विलपितपरिवेदनाकुलं व्यसनगतं तदभूत् सुदुःखितम्॥
en: And the abode of Dasaratha which formerly resounded with Murajas, Panavas, meghas,* was now filled with cries of distress and lamentations. *Musical instruments.

sa: यदेषा साध्विति ब्रूयात् कार्यं तन्मुक्तसंशयम्। नहि तारामतं किंचिदन्यथा परिवर्तते॥
en: Do you, without the least doubt perform what shall the chaste lady instruct you to do; for Tārā's advice never goes without effect.

sa: इत्येवमुक्तः सुग्रीवो वालिना भ्रातृसौहृदात्। हर्षं त्यक्त्वा पुनर्दीनो ग्रहग्रस्त इवोडुराट्॥
en: Having been accosted thus by Vāli, out of fraternal affection, Sugrīva renouncing joy again became pale like to the Moon possessed by Rahu.

sa: अथ तद्भस्मनां राशिं गङ्गासलिलमुत्तमम्। प्लावयत् पूतपाप्मानः स्वर्गं प्राप्ता रघुत्तम॥
en: The excellent waters of Gangā overflowed that heap of ashes; and thereupon, O best of the Raghus, they their sins purged; attained heaven.

sa: तथा विलपतां तेषामतृप्तानां च राघवः। अचक्षुर्विषयं प्रायाद् यथार्कः क्षणदामुखे।७।।
en: And as they kept lamenting, unsatiated in beholding him, Rāghava went beyond the range of their sight, like the Sun disappearing at nightfall.

sa: कर्म कुर्वन्ति विधिवद् याजका वेदपारगाः। यथाविधि यथान्यायं परिक्रामन्ति शास्त्रतः॥
en: And the priests, each duly and according to the ordinance performing his proper part, engaged in the ceremony in consonance with the scriptures.

sa: वाली नाम महाप्राज्ञ शक्रपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। अध्यास्ते वानरः श्रीमान् किष्किन्धामतुलप्रभाम्॥
en: O greatly wise one, there lives in Kişkindhā, of incomparable beauty, the mighty and highly graceful monkey—the son of Sakra, by name Vali.

sa: अथवा स्वयमेवाहं सुमित्रानुचरा सुखम्। अग्निहोत्रं पुरस्कृत्य प्रस्थास्ये यत्र राघवः॥
en: Or first performing the fire-sacrifice, I followed by Sumitrā, will myself happily seek the way by which Rāghava (has gone to the woods).

sa: ततः पद्मादिभिस्तत्र निधिभिः स तदा वृतः। धनदोच्छ्वासितस्तैस्तु वनमानीय नन्दनम्॥
en: Thereat Padma and other Nidhi deities, surrounding the granter the granter of wealth, raised him up and brought him to the Nandana wood.

sa: एष दोषो महान् हि स्यान्मम सीताभिभाषणे। प्राणत्यागश्च वैदह्या भवेदनभिभाषणे॥
en: It is a great sin in me (I own) to talk with Sita-But she will die if I do not talk with her.

sa: सत्यं राक्षसराजेन्द्र शृणुष्व वचनं मम। रामदासस्य दूतस्य वानरस्य विशेषतः॥
en: O sovereign of the Rākṣasas, do you faithfully listen to these words of me, a monkey and the servant and envoy of Rāma.

sa: ततः पुनर्महातेजाः कुम्भयोनिमहायशाः। उवाच रामं प्रणतं पितामह इवेश्वरम्॥ श्रूयतामिति चोवाच रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्। कथाशेषं महातेजाः कथयामास स प्रभुः॥ यथाख्यानं श्रुतं चैव यथावृत्तं यथा तथा। प्रीतात्मा कथयामास राघवाय महामतिः॥ एतदर्थं महाबाहो रावणेन दुरात्मना। सुता जनकराजस्य हृता राम महामते॥
en: The highly effulgent and illustrious Agastya, spring from a vessel, again addressed the humble Rāma as the great Patriarch sprung from lotus spoke to the Great Deity. He said to Răma, having truth for his prowess:-"Do you hear." Saying this, the highly effulgent Agastya began to narrate the last portion of the story. The high-minded saint, with a delighted heart, described to Rāma all he has heard and narrated." O high-minded Rama, having long arms, it is for this reason that the vicioussouled Rāvana stole away Janaki, the daughter of king Janaka.

sa: पुलस्त्याज्ञां प्रगृह्याथ न किंचन वचोऽर्जुनः। मुमोचैव पार्थिवेन्द्रो राक्षसेन्द्रं प्रहृष्टवत्॥
en: Hearing this command of Pulastya, the king Arjuna did not utter a single world and set, most delightedly the king of Räkşasas, free.

sa: इहाहं यदि तिष्ठामि स्वेन रूपेण संवृतः। विनाशमुपयास्यामि भर्तुरर्थश्च हास्यति॥
en: Should I stay here embodied in my native form, I shall come by destruction; and the interest also of my master shall suffer.

sa: धिङ्गमनार्यामसती याहं तेन विना कृता। मुहूर्तमपि जीवामि जीवितं पापजीविका॥
en: Woe to me! who am unchaste and vile and my life is vicious, since breathe I still in the absence of my lord.

sa: अथोवाच रघुश्रेष्ठः सागरं दारुणं वचः। अद्याहं शोषयिष्यामि सपातालं महार्णवम्॥
en: Then the foremost of Raghus addressed Ocean in stern words, saying, To-day will I dry up the Ocean along with the nether regions.

sa: एतस्मिनन्तरे वीरो गदापाणिविभीषणः। सुग्रीवं वर्धयामास राघवं च जयाशिषा ॥
en: In the meanwhile that hero, Vibhisana, bearing a mace in his hand, (approaching) greeted Sugrīva as well as Rāghava with blessings of victory.

sa: ऊरुभ्यामुदरं छाद्य बाहुभ्यां च पयोधरौ। उपविष्टा विशालाक्षी रुदती वरवर्णिनी॥
en: Having covered her belly with her legs and her breast with her hands, that one, having charming colour and expansive eyes, cried aloud.

sa: ईश्वरस्येश्वरः कोऽस्ति तव शत्रुनिबर्हण। रमस्व सह वैदेह्या शत्रूनाक्रम्य मूर्धसु॥
en: O destroyer of foes, who is the lord of you, that are lord yourself? Enjoy with Vaidehi, taking your enemy by the hand.

sa: संगत्या भरतः श्रीमानराज्येनार्थी स्वयं भवेत्। प्रशास्तु वसुधां सर्वामखिलां रघुनन्दनः॥
en: If the effulgent Bharata, the descendant of Raghu, ruling over it, wish the kingdom for himself, let him lord over the entire earth.

sa: न्यायेन राजकार्याणि यः करोति दशानन। न स संतप्यते पश्चानिश्चितार्थमतिर्नृपः॥
en: O ten-faced one, the king, that arriving at certain conclusions, carry on his regal affairs agreeably to justice, has not to repent afterwards.

sa: तन्निवर्तय लङ्केशाद्दण्डमेतं समुद्यतम्। सत्यं च मां कुरुष्वाद्य लोकांस्त्वं यद्यवेक्षसे॥
en: Therefore do you keep your uplifted weapon off Larkā's lord. If you have any care for these worlds do you establish my truth.

sa: सिंहशार्दूलवाञ्छैलः संचचाल चलद्रुमः। बभूवः चापि क्षुभितः समुद्रः सरितां पतिः॥
en: And mountains abounding with lions and tigers began to tremble, and trees to shiver. And even the deep-lord of streams-was wrought up wondrously.

sa: पतितं समभिज्ञाय राक्षसी सा महाचमूः। वध्यमाना दिशो भेजे हरिभिर्जितकाशिभिः॥
en: And knowing (Indrajit) fallen (in fight), the mighty army of Rākşasas, attacked by monkeys burning for victory, fled in the ten cardinal directions.

sa: तमास्थाय रथश्रेष्ठं महामेघसमस्वनम्। प्रययौ रक्षसां श्रेष्ठो दशग्रीवः सभां प्रति॥
en: Having ascended that excellent vehicle, having sounds resembling those of mighty clouds, that foremost of Raksasa, the Tennecked one, drove towards the court.

sa: न स शक्यस्तुलयितुं व्यसनैः पुरुषर्षभः। अहं तस्यानुभावज्ञा शक्रस्येव पुलोमजा॥
en: The disaster-creating Rākşasas can never be compared with that best of men. I am cognizant of his prowess as Sacī is of Indra's.

sa: इति स्वमन्त्रिणां मध्ये भ्राता भ्रातरमूचिवान्। रावणं रक्षसां श्रेष्ठं पथ्यमेतद्विभीषणः॥
en: (Ravana's) brother, Vibhisana, thus spoke, to his brother, the chief of Rākşasa, in the midst of counsellors, these words fraught with his good.

sa: आसाद्य रणमध्ये तं वारयित्वा स्थितो ज्वलन्। धनुर्विस्फारयामास राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Entering into the arena of fight and posted there flaming, the powerful lord of the Rakşasas, baffling (the foe), kept stretching his bow.

sa: ततो वानरसैन्येन मुक्तो नादः समन्ततः। मलयः पूरितो येन ससानुप्रस्थकंदरः॥
en: Then the monkeys-army gave roar, spreading all around, and it seemed as if the sound filled all Malaya with its sides and caves.

sa: राजा जयति सुग्रीव इति शब्दो महानभूत्। राजञ्जयजयेत्युक्त्वा स्वस्वनामकथां ततः॥
en: A mighty sound arose of 'Victory to king Sugrīva!' and 'Victory to you, O king,' each army taking the name of its king.

sa: किं तु पूर्व गतास्म्येका महर्षे वितात्मनः। पुलस्त्यस्याश्रमं दिव्यमन्वेष्टुं स्वसखीजनम्॥
en: But searching for my associates, I had ere this alone repaired to the noble asylum of the Maharși Pulastya of a purified spirit.

sa: मच्छरीरं समासाद्य कान्तो नित्यं भविष्यसि। प्राप्स्यसे चातुलां प्रीतिमेतन्मे प्रीतिलक्षणम्॥
en: And approaching my person you shall ever be beautiful to behold; and you shall, as a sign of my gratification, attain unparalleled complacence.

sa: तद् भग्नं वनखण्डं तु भ्रान्तत्रस्तमृगद्विजम्। प्रतिबुद्ध्य निरीक्षन्ते राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः॥
en: The whole forest was devastated the birds and deer strayed away in fear and the Rākşasīs, having terrible faces, awaking, beheld all that.

sa: द्विजेन्द्रपक्षवातेन द्रावितं दृश्य पूर्वजम्। सुमाली स्वबलैः सार्धं लङ्कामभिमुखो ययौ॥
en: Seeing his elder brother driven by the wind produced by the wings of that bird, Sumali along with his forces, made for Lankā.

sa: निर्बिभेदोरसि तदा रावणं निशितैः शरैः। राघवः परमायचो ललाटे पत्रिभिस्त्रिभिः॥
en: Then he pierced Rāvana in the chest with whetted arrows. And the energetic Rāghava hit (Rāvaņa) in the temples with three feathered shafts.

sa: वालिना हृतराज्येन सुग्रीवेण सह प्रभुः। चक्रेऽग्निसाक्षिकं सख्यं राघवः सहलक्ष्मणः॥
en: And in the presence of fire, Rāma, along wi Lakşmaņa, contracted friendship with me who had been deprived of his kingdom by Vāli.

sa: प्रेषितस्ते महावीरो हनुमानवलोककः। लङ्कास्थाहं त्वया राजन्कि तदा न विसर्जिता॥
en: O king, when the great hero Hanumān was despatched by you of Lankā to see me why did you not renounce me then?

sa: शूरो धीमारथी खङ्गी रथप्रवरमास्थितः। हत्वा दाशरथिं भीमं भवान्प्राप्स्यति मैथिलीम्॥
en: Heroic, and intelligent, a mighty car-warrior and swordsman, you, mounted on a car, slay the redoubtable son of Dasaratha, will obtain Mithilā's daughter.

sa: सोऽहं दृष्टबलस्तुभ्यमिच्छामि हरिपुङ्गव। त्वया सह चिरं सख्यं सुस्निग्धं पावकाग्रतः॥
en: Your prowess has been sufficiently displayed. But bow I wish, O king of monkeys, to make friends with you for ever before fire.

sa: सबिभीषणसुग्रीवाः सर्वे ते वानरर्षभाः। प्रतस्थिरे विनर्दन्तो धृतानां द्विषतां वधे॥
en: And all the principal monkeys-Sugrīva with Vibhisana-went on, setting up roars, for the destruction of foes, who were determined to battle with them.

sa: नैवं राक्षसशार्दूल त्यज्यतामेष निश्चयः। राजशास्त्रव्यपेतो हि मार्गः संलक्ष्यते त्वया॥
en: O you foremost of the Rākṣasas, do you alter your resolution. The way, you are following, is beyond the pale of royal policy.

sa: सागरश्च मयाऽक्रान्तः श्रीमान् नदनदीपतिः। अस्या हेतोर्विशालाक्ष्याः पुरी चेयं निरीक्षिता॥
en: And it is for this (damsel) of expansive eyes that I have crossed the effulgent lord of rivers and have seen this city.

sa: ततस्तस्या हितं सख्याश्चिकीर्षन्ती सखी वचः। उवाच काले कालज्ञा स्मितपूर्वाभिभाषिणी॥
en: Then, desirous of doing her good, (Sita's) friend, conversant with season, and ever precluding her speech with a smile, spoke to her seasonably.

sa: तदिहैव निवेशोऽस्तु मन्त्रः प्रस्तूयतामिह । यथेदं वानरबलं परं पारमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Let the monkey-host be encamped here therefore, and then concert a plan by means of which they might get at the other side.

sa: वीर सौम्य प्रबुध्यस्व कौसल्याप्रीतिवर्धन। जगद्धिसर्व स्वपिति त्वयि सुप्ते नराधिप।४।।
en: Awake, O gentle hero, increasing Kausalya's joy, O foremost of men. Yourself being asleep the whole universe will be laid up with sleep.

sa: किमर्थमहमादृत्य भवद्भिः प्रतिबोधितः। कच्चित्सुकुशलं राज्ञो भयं वा नेह किंचन॥
en: Why, being honoured, have I been awakened by you? Is it well with the king? Or has any fear : sprung up here?

sa: एष शापवशादेव न वेद बलमात्मनः। बालिसुग्रीवयोवैरं यदा राम समुत्थितम्॥
en: O Rāma! Hanuman could not be conscious of his power due to the curse at the time of altercations between Sugrīva and Vāli.

sa: शतान्यहं योजनानां क्रमेयं सुबहून्यपि। किं पुनः सागरस्यान्तं संख्यातं शतयोजनम्॥
en: I am competent to bound over many hundreds of Yojanas. What then is this end of the ocean measuring an hundred Yojanas only?

sa: रथं शीघ्रमिमं सूत राघवाभिमुखं नय। नाहत्वा समरे शत्रूनिवर्तिष्यति रावणः॥
en: O charioteer, do you swiftly take the car towards Rāghava. Without slaying his foe in fight, Ravana turn not away (from the field).

sa: कुर्वत्यः कलहं घोरं सारिकास्तद्रथं प्रति। निपेतुः शतशस्तत्र दारुणा दारुणारुताः॥
en: Setting up a dreadful quarrel hundreds of terrible Särikās* began to fall down on his chariot. *A kind of bird (Turdus Salica, Buch).

sa: निमेषान्तरमात्रेण घोरैरग्निशिखोपमैः। दिशश्चकार विमलाः प्रदिशश्च महारथः॥ ये त्वन्ये राक्षसा वीरा रामस्याभिमुखे स्थिताः। तेऽपि नष्टाः समासाद्य पतङ्गा इव पावकम्॥
en: Then in the twinkling of an eye, that Mahāratha rendered all sides clear (of all gloom) by means of arrows resembling tongues of fire; and those other heroic Raksasas that were in front of Rāma, were destroyed on approaching the place, like insects approaching a fire.

sa: स हि योधान्हतान्मत्वा क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः। अब्रवीत्त्वरितः सूतं रथो मे उपनीयताम्॥
en: Knowing that his forces had been slain, he, with his eyes crimsoned with passion hastily spoke to his charioteer, ‘Bring you my car.'

sa: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो महाबलः। वायुपुत्रं महावेगं वहन्तं राघवं रणे॥ रोषेण महताविष्टः पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन्। आजघान शरैर्दीप्तैः कालानलशिखोपमैः॥
en: Hearing Rāghava's words, the exceedingly strong lord of the Rākşasas, overwhelmed with a mighty wrath, recalling enmity a gone, with burning shafts resembling the fire of Doom hit in encounter the exceedingly impetuous offspring of the Wind-god, who was bearing Rāghava.

sa: तच्छूलं निहतं दृष्ट्वा रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। साधु साध्विति भूतानि व्याहरन्ति नभोगताः॥
en: Beholding that dart beffled thus by Rāma of unwearied actions all those, stationed in the welkin began to shout, “Well done! Well done!"

sa: अथवा राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन दुरात्मना। छद्मना घातितौ शूरौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: Or those two heroic brothers Rāma and Laksmana, have been, by treachery, put to death, by the vicious-souled Rāvana, the lord of Raksasas.

sa: सुग्रीवस्त्वथ तद्वाक्यमाभाष्य च विमृश्य च। ततः शुभतरं वाक्यमुवाच हरिपुंगवः॥
en: There upon hearing his words and considering them well, Sugrīva, the lord of the monkeys, replied in more auspicious* word. *More reasonable word.

sa: आवामिहागतौ सौम्य रावणप्रहितावुभौ। परिज्ञातुं बलं सर्वं तदिदं रघुनन्दन ॥
en: O placid one, commanded by Ravana, we have come here, O son of Raghu, for the purpose of gathering information concerning this army.

sa: देहीत्यन्यो ददात्यन्यो ददामीत्यपरः पुनः। किं क्लेशयसि तिष्ठेति तत्रान्योन्यं बभाषिरे॥
en: One was crying 'Give.'* and his adversary anon give; and another, again said, I will give. Why put yourself to trouble? Stay. *Battle.

sa: अयोध्यां त्वरितो गत्वा शीघ्रं प्लवगसत्तम। जानीहि कच्चित्कुशली जनो नृपतिमन्दिरे॥
en: O foremost of monkeys, speedily repairing to Ayodhyā do you learn of the welfare of all people in the palace of the king.

sa: लक्ष्मणं परिवार्यैवं तिष्ठध्वं वानरोत्तमाः। पराक्रमस्य कालोऽयं संप्राप्तो मे चिरेप्सितः॥
en: You foremost of monkeys do you stay here surrounding Lakṣmaṇa. The opportunity for putting forth my prowess which I had sought, is present.

sa: जवेन महता युक्तो मारुतितिरंहसा। जगाम हरिशार्दूलो दिशः शब्देन नादयन्।५१।।
en: That powerful monkey possessed of the speed of the Wind itself, and having mighty impetuosity, careered, making all sides resound with his roars.

sa: पिता दानवराजो मे भर्ता मे राक्षसेश्वरः॥ पुत्रो मे शक्रनिर्जेता इत्यहं गर्विता भृशम्। दृप्तारिमथनाः क्रूराः प्रख्यातबलपौरुषाः॥ अकुतश्चिद्भया नाथा ममेत्यासीन्मतिर्बुवा।
en: My father is the king of Dănvas, my husband the lord of Rākşasas, and my son the subduer of Śakra. I was greatly proud of this and always confident that my protectors were undaunted dreadful, repressors of the enemies and famous for their strength and manliness.

sa: बस्वोकसारप्रतिमां समीक्ष्य नगरी ततः। खमिवोत्पतितां लङ्कां जहर्ष हनुमान् कपिः॥
en: And then beholding the city Lankā, resembling Vasvokasāra,* and appearing to mount to the welkin, the monkey Hanumān was filled with rapture. *Alaka.

sa: अरिघ्नं सिंहसंकाशं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम्। लक्ष्मणं च धनुष्मन्नं लङ्काद्वारमुपागतम्॥
en: You shall soon behold before Lanka's gate Rāghava the slayer of foes resembling a lion and Lakşmana with a bow in his hand.

sa: अद्य काकाश्च गृध्राश्च ये च मांसाशिनोऽपरे। सर्वांस्तांस्तर्पयिष्यामि शत्रुमांसैः शराहतैः॥
en: I shall satisfy today with the flesh of the enemies slain by my shafts, the crows, vultures and others who live upon flesh.

sa: तदलं परितापेन देवि मन्युरपैतु ते। एकोत्पातेन ते लङ्कामेष्यन्ति हरियूथपाः॥
en: No more of bewailing, O worshipful dame. Do you remove your grief. And with one leap these leaders of monkey-hosts shall reach Lankā.

sa: तां पुरी तादृशीं दृष्ट्वा दुराधर्षां सुरासुरैः। हनूमांश्चिन्तयामास विनिःश्वस्य मुहूर्मुहुः॥
en: Beholding the city in that state, difficult of being subdued by the celestials and Asuras (combined), Hanumān, sighing moment arily, thought within himself,

sa: इमे हि संरब्धतरास्तदा तैः सम्प्रधर्षिताः। निवार्यन्ते वनात् तस्मात् क्रुद्धैर्वानरपुङ्गवैः॥
en: When these attendants, being insulted by them, were greatly wroth, they were driven out of the garden, by those powerful and enraged monkeys.

sa: ततोऽस्तं गत आदित्ये रौद्रे तस्मिन्निशामुखे। लङ्कामभिमुखाः सोल्का जग्मुस्ते प्लवगर्षभाः॥
en: Then when the Sun had set and at the terrific front of Night, those foremost of monkeys marched towards Larikā, equipped with firebrands.

sa: ते वध्यमाना हरयो नाराचैर्भीमविक्रमैः॥ सौमित्रिं शरणं प्राप्ताः प्रजापतिमिव प्रजाः।
en: And slaughtered by närâchas of terrific impetuosity, the monkeys saught the shelter of Sumitrā's son, like creatures seeking the refuge of their lord.

sa: शोकजालेन महता विततेन न राजतीम्। संसक्तां धूमजालेन शिखामिव विभावसोः॥
en: Entangled by a mighty web of grief her grace was greatly lessened and she appeared like the flame of fire enveloped in smoke.

sa: स प्रविष्टो मधुवनं ददर्श हरियूथपान्। विमदानुद्धतान् सर्वान् मेहमानान् मधूदकम्॥
en: And entering that forest he beheld all the leaders of the monkeys spending the hours delightedly, having passed urine, the outcome of honey.

sa: अहो रूपमहो धैर्यमहो सत्त्वमहो द्युतिः। अहो राक्षसराजस्य सर्वलक्षणयुक्तता ॥ यद्यधर्मो न बलवान् स्यादयं राक्षसेश्वरः। स्यादयं सुरलोकस्य सशक्रस्यापि रक्षिता॥
en: Ah! the form! Ah! the patience! Ah! the strength! Ah! the splendour! Ah! the entire auspiciousness of the king of Rākşasas! If the lord of Rākṣasas were not impious to the height, this one could well be the protector themselves of the celestial regions with Śakra.

sa: स्वमनीकं विषण्णं तु श्रुत्वा शत्रुभिरर्दितम्। उदतिष्ठत दुर्धर्षः स कर्मण्यननुष्ठिते॥
en: Hearing his own army hard beset by the enemies, and dropping, the unconquerable one, ere yet he had finished his rites, rose up.

sa: वृक्षान्धकारान्निर्गम्य जातक्रोधः स रावणिः। आरुरोह रथं सज्ज पूर्वयुक्तं सुसंयतम्॥
en: Issuing from the gloom of the trees, Ravana's son, fired with wrath, ascended his car, which had already been well yoked (with steeds).

sa: स राक्षसानां तत्सैन्यं कालाग्निरिव निर्दहन्। चकार बहुभिर्वृक्षैनि:संज्ञं युधि वानरः॥
en: In that encounter, the monkey, consuming (the forces) like the fire risen at Doomsday, made that army of Rākşasas insensible with innumerable trees.

sa: ततः स रोषमापन्नः शशास सचिवांस्तदा। गृह्यतामिति दुर्मेधा वध्यतामिति चासकृत्॥
en: And coming under the sway of passion, he commanded his counsellors, saying, "Take this one of perverse understanding, and slay him at once.”

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रक्षो मायाबलमथात्मनः। आरब्धुमुपसंपेदे ज्ञात्वा तं वानराधिपः॥ उत्पपात तदाकाशं जिकाशी जितक्लमः। रावणं स्थित एवात्र हरिराजेन वञ्चितः॥
en: In the meanwhile the Rākşasa attempted to put forth his power of illusion. Knowing this, the king of monkeys shot into the sky. And Rāvana, overpowered by fatigue and out of breath, thus baffled by the monkey-king, stood where he was.

sa: चकम्पे मेदिनी कृतस्ना सशैलवनकानना। भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चासीन ववौ चापि मारुतः॥
en: Greatly shook the earth with her mountains, forests and gardens. The Sun was shorn of its resplendence and the wind blew very rough.

sa: शूराश्च बलवन्तश्च कृतास्त्राश्च नरा रणे। कालाभिपन्नाः सीदन्ति यथा वालुकसेतवः॥
en: Even the heroic and powerful persons, well versed in the use of weapons, wear away like sands in battle, being attracted by Death.

sa: दीप्तपावकसंकाशैः शितैः काञ्चनभूषणैः। न त्वामिच्छाम्यहं द्रष्टुं रामेण निहतं शरैः॥
en: I do not wish to behold you slain by the well sharpened shafts of Rāma, feathered in gold and resembling the flaming fire.

sa: सुग्रीव सत्त्वसंपन्न महाबलपराक्रम। किं मया खलु वक्तव्यो रावणो लोकरावणः॥
en: O Sugrīva, O you gifted with great energy, O you of great prowess, what shall I speak to Rāvana, dreaded by all people?

sa: दक्षिणस्योदधेस्तीरे त्रिकूटो नाम पर्वतः॥ सुवेल इति चाप्यन्यो द्वितीयो राक्षसेश्वराः।
en: 'On the shore of the Southern sea is a mountain named Trikūța. A second also is there called Suvela, you lords of Raksasas.

sa: दशग्रीव तथा यत्नं कुरुष्वामितविक्रम। यथा त्वमपि मे पुत्र भवेर्वैश्रवणोपमः।॥
en: Therefore, O Ten-necked one, O you of measureless prowess, do you so strive that you also, my son, may be like Vaisravana himself.

sa: ये तु तत्रोत्तरे कूले समुद्रस्य महाबलाः॥ पूर्वं संविष्ठिता शूरा वायुपुत्रदिदृक्षवः। महतो वायुनुनस्य तोयदस्येव नि:स्वनम्। शुश्रुवुस्ते तदा घोषमूरुवेगं हनूमतः॥
en: And (it came to pass that) those powerful and heroic (monkeys) that had formerly stationed themselves on the northern shore of the ocean, anxious to see the Wind-god's offspring, heard the sounds proceeding from Hanuman's vehement speed, resembling the rumbling of clouds agitated by the winds.

sa: दुःखेन बुबुधे सीतां हनुमाननलंकृताम्। संस्कारेण यश हीनां वाजमर्थान्तरं गताम्॥
en: Seeing her without ornaments he could with great difficulty make her out like to words having different meanings without the knowledge of grammar.

sa: इषुधी चाक्षयैर्बाणै रथं च कपिलक्षणम्। मोक्षयामास बीभत्सुर्मयं यत्र महासुरम्॥
en: An inexhaustible quiver and one warchariot, bearing an ape as its standard. On this occasion did Arjuna rescue the frightened great Asura Maya.

sa: आमन्त्र्य तु महात्मानं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्। भरतं लक्ष्मणं चैव महारथमुपारुहत्॥
en: Thereupon having invited Bharata and Laksmana, the high-souled Rama, having truth for his prowess, speedily went for his city in a huge chariot.

sa: मित्रोदासीनशत्रूणां कच्चिद् वेत्सि चिकीर्षितम्। कच्चित् संधिं यथाकालं विग्रहं चोपसेवसे॥
en: Do you ascertain what your friends, your enemies and the ascetics are doing? Do you make war and peace at the proper time?

sa: सुराणामसुराणां च समजायत वै मिथः। ऐश्वर्य प्रति संघर्षस्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे॥
en: In the days of yore, great battles were often faught between the Devas and the Asuras for the sovereignty over the three worlds.

sa: एषा नो नैष्ठिकी बुद्धिः सर्वेषामीक्षणश्रवः। अथ यन्मन्यसे राजन्दुतं तत्संविधीयताम्॥
en: O snake, that hears by the eyes, this is the final result of our deliberations. O king, do speedily what you think proper.

sa: अपरे त्वब्रुवन्नागा धर्मात्मानो दयालवः। अबुद्धिरेषा भवतां ब्रह्महत्या न शोभनम्॥
en: Some other snakes, who were kind hearted and virtuous, said, “Your this advice is not good. It is not proper to kill Brahmanas.”

sa: धर्मशीला जनपदाः सुसंतोषाश्च साधवः। न च मिथ्याप्रलापोऽत्र स्वैरेष्वपि कुतोऽन्यथा॥
en: The cities in this kingdom are all devoted to virtue. The people are honest and contented. They never speak falsehood even in jest.

sa: स पूर्वदेवचरितं तदा तत्र विशाम्पते। कथयामास दैतेयः पाण्डुपुत्रेषु भारत॥
en: O king, O descendant of Bharata, then that son of Diti (Maya) narrated before the sons of Pandu the old history of (Vrishaparva).

sa: संकर्षणद्वितीयेन ज्ञातिकार्यं मया कृतम्। हतौ कंससुनामानौ मया रामेण चाप्युत॥
en: I did a service to my relatives. Making Samkarasiana (Baladeva) my second, I killed both Kansa and Sunama with the assistance of Rama.

sa: कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य सशिष्योऽङ्गिरसां वरः। जगाम गङ्गामभितो मज्जितुं भरतर्षभ।॥
en: O best ɔf the Bharata race, some time after, the best of Angirasa (Drona) with his pupils went to the Ganges to bathe.

sa: तस्येमे स्वर्गभूतस्य क्षुत्पिपासे द्विजोत्तम। बाधेते परमे वीर ततोऽहं व्यथितेन्द्रियः॥
en: And albeit I had reached the Brahmā region I was still being assailed by hunger and thirst. And gradually I grew tired therewith.

sa: स धर्ममाहूय पुरा महर्षिरिदमुक्तवान्। इषिकया मया बाल्याद्विद्धा ह्येका शकुन्तिका॥
en: Thereupon, the great Rishi called Dharma and addressed him thus, “In my childhood I pierced a little fly with a blade of grass."

sa: वज्रसंहनना वीरा वीर्यवन्तो महारथाः। स्मरन्तो मध्यमं देशं वृष्णिमध्ये व्यवस्थिताः॥
en: Possessing great prowess, all these heroes are as mighty as the thunderbolt. These Maharathas, choosing the middle country, now live among the Vrishnis.

sa: ततः काश्मीरकान् वीरान् क्षत्रियान् क्षत्रियर्षभः। व्यजयल्लोहितं चैव मण्डलैर्दशभिः सह॥
en: That best of Kshatriyas (Arjuna) then vanquished the brave Kshatriyas of Kashmira and also the king Lohita, as well as ten minor chiefs.

sa: अभिषेक्तुकामं नृपति पूरुं पुत्रं कनीयसम्। ब्राह्मणप्रमुखा वर्णा इदं वचनमब्रुवन्॥
en: Yayati became desirous of installing his youngest son Puru on the throne. But the four orders of his subject with Brahmanas at their

sa: सम्प्रेक्षमाणा पुत्रं ते नानुरूपमिवात्मनः। अनर्हवशमापन्नामिमां चापि सुतां तव॥ अवज्ञाता च लोकेषु तथाऽऽत्मानमजानती। अवलिप्तैनरैर्ब्रह्मन् मरिष्यामि न संशयः॥
en: Seeing your son (thoroughly) unlike yourself and your daughter under the control of unworthy person. I shall be despised in the world. I do not know what will happen to me. O Brahmana, there is no doubt I shall certainly die.

sa: ततः सर्वस्य रङ्गस्य समुत्पिञ्जलकोऽभवत्। प्रावाद्यन्त च वाद्यानि सशङ्खानि समन्ततः॥
en: On this a great cry of joy rose from all parts of the arena and musical instruments were played and conches were blown.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तयोर्दुःखितयोर्वाक्यमतिमात्रं निशम्य तु। ततो दुःखपरीताङ्गी कन्या तावभ्यभाषत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard these words of her affected parents, the daughter was filled with grief and she thus spoke (to them.)

sa: तेषां श्रुत्वा स नागेन्द्रस्तां कन्यां समलंकृताम्। प्रगृह्यारण्यमगमत्समीपं तस्य पन्नगः॥
en: The king of the snakes immediately went to the place where the Rishi was, taking with him his sister, decked with various ornaments.

sa: तथेत्युक्त्वा ततः प्रायाद् बृहस्पतिसुत: कचः। तदाभिपूजिता देवैः समीपे वृषपर्वणः॥
en: Having been thus addressed and worshipped by the celestials, he said, “Be it so." He then went to the court of king Vrishaparva.

sa: ततो देवः सहस्राक्षस्तूर्णं वायुमचोदयत्। विक्षिपेमां रजोवृष्टिं तवेदं कर्म मारुत॥
en: Thereupon the celestials, the god of thousand eyes (Indra), commanded Vayu, saying, “O Maruta, it is your work to drive the dust away.

sa: कच्चिदर्थान् विनिश्चित्य लघुमूलान् महोदयान्। क्षिप्रमारभसे कर्तुं न विघ्नयसि तादृशान्॥
en: Do you without procrastination accomplish measures of great utility that can be easily accomplished? Such measures are surely never obstructed (in your Kingdom).

sa: त्वत्कृते च निमिष्यन्ति चढूंषि पृथिवीपते। वायुभूतेन चरता विश्रामार्थं मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: The exhaustion, that their their eyes shall experience on account of your moving about as the air, shall be removed within this moment.

sa: यद्यसौ तप आतिष्ठेद्भूय एव सुरेश्वर। यावल्लोका धरिष्यन्ति तावदस्य वशानुगाः॥
en: O illustrious Sir, if his ascetic powers grow more we shall be constrained to live under his control for ever from the creation.

sa: अथाब्रवीच्च तं भ्राता सुप्रतीकं विभावसुः। विभागं बहवो मोहात्कर्तुमिच्छन्ति नित्यशः॥
en: Some time after Vibhavasu told his brother S ratika, “It is from foolishness, blinded by wealth, that many wish to divide (paternal) wealth.

sa: सुरैश्च परमोदारैर्दैतेयैश्च महाधनैः। नागराक्षसगन्धर्वैर्यक्षैश्च सुमहात्मभिः॥ पूज्यते नित्यशः सौम्य भयार्ते रघुनन्दन । अबिभ्यश्च त्रयो लोकाः सरोषस्य महात्मनः॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, being terrified, the generous deities, the rich Daityas, the highly powerful Nägas, the irrepressible Rakşasas, Gandharvas and Yakşas used to adore him perpetually. The high-souled Ila being enraged, the three worlds used to be convulsed with terror.

sa: प्रवादितैश्च वादित्रैर्जनकौतूहलेन च। महार्णव इव क्षुब्धः समाजः सोऽभवत् तदा॥
en: That vast crowd with the noise of blowing trumpets and beating drums and the sounds of many voices became like an agitated ocean.

sa: एकरात्रं तु ते ब्रह्मन् कामं दास्यामि भोजनम्। एवमुक्तस्त्वहं तेन सदारः प्रस्थितस्तदा॥ तां प्रतिज्ञा प्रतिज्ञाय यां कर्तास्म्यचिरादिव। दुपदेनैवमुक्तोऽहं मन्युनाभिपरिप्लुतः॥
en: O Brahmana, I can give you food and shelter for one night.” Having been thus addressed, I left his presence with my wife, vowing to do that which I shall certainly do without much delay. O Bhishma, thus insulted by Drupada I was filled with wrath.

sa: सह भार्ये विनिष्क्रान्ते तस्मिन्विप्रे च पक्षिराट्। वितत्य पक्षावाकाशमुत्पपात मनोजवः॥
en: When the Brahmana with his wife came out, the king of the birds, fleet as mind, stretching his wings, rose to the sky.

sa: ततः संवदतोरेवं सूतलक्ष्मणयोः पथि। अस्तम गते वासं केशिन्यां तावथोषतुः॥
en: They thus conversing with one another on their way back, the sun set. They accordingly spent that night on the banks of Kesini.

sa: पर्यरक्षन्त तां तत्र शकुन्ता मेनकात्मजाम्। उपस्प्रष्टुं गतश्चाहमपश्यं शयितामिमाम्॥ निर्जने विपिने रम्ये शकुन्तैः परिवारिताम्। आनयित्वा ततश्चैनां दुहितृत्वे न्यवेशयम्॥ शरीरकृत् प्राणदाता यस्य चान्नानि भुञ्जते। क्रमेणैते त्रयोऽप्युक्ताः पितरो धर्मशासने॥ ॥
en: The vultures protected the life of Menaka's child. I had gone there to perform my ablutions. I saw the child lying. In the deep solitude of the forest, surrounded by the vultures. Bringing her here, I have made her my daughter. According to the scriptures, the maker of the body, the protector of life and the giver of food, these three, are in their order considered to be fathers.

sa: जातकर्मादिकास्तस्य क्रियाः स मुनिसत्तमः। पौत्रस्य भरतश्रेष्ठ चकार भगवान् स्वयम्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, that best of Rishis, that illustrious man (Vasishtha), himself performed the usual birth ceremonies of his grandson.

sa: कार्तवीर्यसम: कुंन्ति शिवतुल्यपराक्रमः। एष शक्रः इवाजय्यो यशस्ते प्रथयिष्यति॥ अदित्या विष्णुना प्रीतिर्यथाभूदभिवर्धिता। तथा विष्णुसमः प्रीति वर्धयिष्यति तेऽर्जुनः॥
en: "O Kunti, (this child) will be equal to Kartavirya and Shiva in prowess he will be invincible like Indra himself. He will spread your fame everywhere. As Vishnu enhanced Aditi's joy, so Arjuna (this child) like Vishnu will enhance your joy.

sa: सुरकार्यमियं काले करिष्यति सुमध्यमा। अस्या हेतोः कौरवाणां महदुत्पत्स्यते भयम्॥
en: "This lady of slender waist will in time accomplish the works of gods. From her will arise many fears (dangers) to the Kurus."

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा सर्वपाञ्चालाः प्रणेदुः सिंहसङ्घवत्। न चैतान् हर्षसम्पूर्णानियं सेहे वसुंधरा॥
en: Hearing this all the Panchalas uttered a loud leonine roars. The earth was unable to bear the weight of the madly joyous Panchalas.

sa: ततस्ते पाण्डवा कुन्त्या सहिता हास्तिनपुरमानीय तापसैर्भीष्मस्य च विदुरस्य च निवेदिताः। सर्ववर्णानां च निवेद्यान्तर्हितास्तापसा बभूवुः प्रेक्ष्यमाणानां तेषाम्॥
en: Some time after, the Pandu princes, with their mother Kunti, were taken by the ascetics to Hastinapur and they were introduced to Bhishma and Vidura. After introducing them to all the orders, the ascetics disappeared in the very sight of all.

sa: अस्मिंस्तु मानुषे लोके वैशंपायन उक्तवान्। शिष्यो व्यासस्य धर्मात्मा सर्ववेदविदां वरः। एकं शतसहस्रं तु मयोक्तं वै निबोधत॥
en: One of the pupils of Vyasa, Vaishampayana, a man of just principles, the first amongst the learned in the Vedas, recited them in this world of mankind. Know, I (Sauti) have also recited one hundred thousands verses of this great work.

sa: जित्वा स वनवासाय प्रेषयामास तांस्ततः। एतत्सर्वं सभापर्व समाख्यातं महात्मना॥
en: The exile of Yudhishthira with his brothers by the victorious Duryodhana. These are the matters that have been dwelt in the Sabha Parva.

sa: ततः सुह्मांश्च चोलांश्च किरीटी पाण्डवर्षभः। सहितः सर्वसैन्येन प्रामथत् कुरुनन्दनः॥
en: Then that best of the Pandavas the descendant of Kuru, Kirti (Arjuna) marched against the countries, called Sumba and Sumala, and attacked them.

sa: काम्यं हि रूपं पाञ्चाल्या विधात्रा विहितं स्वयम्। बभूवाधिकमन्याभ्यः सर्वभूतमनोहरम्॥
en: The charming beauty of the Panchala princess was modelled by the Creator himself. It was superior to all and charming to all creatures.

sa: पुलोमोवाच अग्निना भगवंस्तस्मै रक्षसेऽहं निवेदिता। ततो मामनयद्रक्षः क्रोशन्ती कुररीमिव॥
en: Puloma said: O Lord, I was made known to the Rakshasa by Agni. He carried me away who was weeping like the Kurari.

sa: पुलस्त्यतीर्थयात्रा च नारदेन महर्षिणा। तीर्थयात्रा च तत्रैव पांडवानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: The arrival of great sage Narada at the holy shrine of Pulastya; the arrival of the highsouled Pandavas also at that holy pilgrimage.

sa: तं चितागतमाज्ञाय वैश्वानरमुखे हुतम्। प्रविष्टा पावकं माद्री हित्वा जीवितमात्मनः॥
en: Seeing him placed on the funeral pyre and about to be burnt down, his wife Madri entered the fire, thus sacrificing her life.

sa: तथैवाश्वतरीणां च दान्तानां वातरंहसाम्। शतान्यञ्जनकेशीनां श्वेतानां पञ्च पञ्च च॥
en: (He also gave them) one thousand mules of white colour with black manes, all possessing the speed of wind and all well trained.

sa: नामानि चक्रिरे तेषां शतशृङ्गनिवासिनः। भक्त्या च कर्मणा चैव तथाशीभिर्विशाम्पते॥
en: The inhabitants (Rishi) of the mountain with the hundred parks, uttering blessings on them and performing the first rites of birth, named them.

sa: आगतोऽहं महाभागमृर्षि कण्वमुपासितुम्। क्व गतो भगवान् भद्रे तन्ममाचक्ष्व शोभने।॥
en: "I have come to worship the greatly blessed Rishi Kanva. O amiable and beautiful lady, tell me where has the illustrious man gone?"

sa: न च ते मानुषेष्वेतत् प्रयोक्तव्यं कथंचन। जगद् विनिर्दहेदेतदल्पतेजसि पातितम्॥
en: You most not use it against any human foe. If hurled at a foe of inferior power, it might burn the whole universe.

sa: श्री: सुरा चैव सोमश्च तुरगश्च मनोजवः। यतो देवास्ततो जग्मुरादित्यपथमाश्रिताः॥
en: Lakshmi, Wine, Moon, Horse (Uchchaishrava) which is fleet as the mind, all directed by Aditya went to the place where the celestials were.

sa: तौ तु लब्धवरौ दृष्ट्वा कृतकामौ मनस्विनौ। सर्वः सुहृज्जनस्ताभ्यां प्रहर्षमुपजग्मिवान्॥
en: Seeing those intelligent beings successful in their desire and crowned with success as regards the boon, their friends and relatives became exceedingly glad.

sa: अतीत्य गङ्गां शोणं च त्रयस्ते प्राङ्मुखास्तदा। कुशचीरच्छदा जग्मुर्मागधं क्षेत्रमच्युताः॥
en: The Ganges, and the Shone, they proceeded eastwards, Going to the heart of the Kusamva (country), the matchlessly effulgent heroes arrived at Magadha.

sa: स देवप्रस्थमासाद्य सेनाविन्दोः पुरं प्रति। बलेन चतुरङ्गेण निवेशमकरोत् प्रभुः॥
en: After his arrival at Devaprastha, the city of Senavindu, the lord (Arjuna) took up his quarters there with his five kinds of troops.

sa: ऐकात्म्यं वासुदेवस्य प्रोक्तवानर्जुनस्य च। यत्र कृष्णो दयापन्नः संधिमिच्छन् महामतिः॥
en: Of the great friendship between Arjuna and Krishna. It was then that great Krishna, moved by pity and being desirous of bringing peace.

sa: वपुषा वर्चसा चैव शिखामिव विभावसोः। प्रसन्नत्वेन कान्त्या च चन्द्ररेखामिवामलाम्॥
en: In splendour of body, she resembled a flame of fire and in benignity and loveliness she resembled the spotless disc of the moon.

sa: को हि सम्बन्धकं श्लाघ्यमीप्सितं यौनमीदृशम्। अतिक्रामन्न तप्येत साक्षादपि शतक्रतुः॥
en: If the bride's father be Indra himself, still he is to repent for rejecting such an exceedingly honourable and desirable proposal of marriage.

sa: क्षुत्पिपासापरिश्रान्तं तर्कयामास वै नृपम्। पतितं पातनं संख्ये शात्रवाणां महीतले॥
en: The minister through the king, that destroyer of hostile forces, had been lying on the ground being overcome with hunger, thirst and fatigue.

sa: त्रयस्तस्य वराः पुत्राः सर्वभूतमनोहराः। शमः कामश्च हर्षश्च तेजसा लोकधारिणः॥
en: He (Dharma) had three excellent sons, charming to all creatures. (They were) Shama, Kama and Harsha, who supported the worlds by their energy.

sa: तमुवाच महातेजा विवस्वान् मुनिसत्तमम्। महर्षे स्वागतं तेऽस्तु कथयस्व यथेप्सितम्॥
en: Then the greatly effulgent Vivasvata thus spoke to that excellent Brahmana, "O great Rishi, welcome to you. Tell me what is your desire.

sa: तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना निवेश्य सुमहापुरम्। यजेयं दीर्घसत्रेण पितुः प्रह्लादयन्मनः॥
en: Having thus reared a highly picturesque city he thought of worshipping the deity by celebrating a sacrifice for the satisfaction of his sire.

sa: पूर्वमेव तु कृष्णस्य वचनात् तं महीधरम्। पुरुषा मण्डयाञ्चक्रुरुपजहश्च भोजनम्॥
en: Before their arrival (at Raivataka), that hill at the command of Krishna, was adorned by many artificers. Much food was also collected there.

sa: ततः सर्वानवद्यागी तपती तपनः स्वयम्। ददौ संवरणस्यार्थे वसिष्ठाय महात्मने॥
en: Then Tapana himself gave to the illustrious Vasishtha (his daughter) Tapati of perfectly faultless features, so that she might be bestowed on Samvarana.

sa: चित्रवाहनदायादं धर्मात् पौरवनन्दनम्। पाण्डवानां प्रियं पुत्रं तस्मात् पालय सर्वदा॥
en: He is the of Chitravahana by inheritance but in real he is the dearest son of Pandavas, therefore, you may protect him always.

sa: तस्य शापस्य शान्त्यर्थं प्रददौ पन्नगोत्तमः। स्वसारमृषये तस्मै सुव्रताय महात्मने।॥
en: To neutralise ve effect of that curse, the best of snakes (Vasuki) married off his sister to the high-souled Rishi of rigid vow.

sa: स भवान् पाण्डुपुत्राणामाज्ञापयतु मा चिरम्। गमनं सहदाराणामेतदत्र मतं मम॥
en: Therefore, O Sir, my opinion is that you should permit the Pandavas to go there with their wife without any further delay. are

sa: तताप सर्वान् दीप्तौजा ब्राह्मणत्वमवाप्तवान्। अपिबच्च ततः सोममिन्द्रेण सह कौशिकः॥
en: Afflicted all with his effulgence, he became a Brahmana. The son of Kushika, (Vishvamitra) at last drank the Soma (ambrosia) with Indra himself.

sa: तत्र राज्ञः समुदितान् सर्वतः समुपागतान्। ददर्श कन्यास्ताश्चैव भीष्मः शान्तनुनन्दनः॥
