en: There the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, saw that many kings and potentates had come from all directions. He also saw those three maidens.

sa: ऋषिपुत्रोऽथ तं धर्मं श्वेतकेतुर्न चक्षमे॥ चकार चैव मर्यादामिमां स्त्रीपुंसयोर्भुवि।
en: The son of the Rishi, Svetaketu, disapproved of this usage and he established the following practice on earth as regards men and women.

sa: सोपसर्प भद्रं ते गच्छ सर्पमहाविष। जनमेजयस्य यज्ञान्ते आस्तीकवचनं स्मर॥
en: O blessed snake, go away, go away, O snake of virulent poison. Remember the words of Astika spoken after the Snake-sacrifice of Janamejaya."

sa: कथं चास्य सुतो जातः सोऽश्वत्थामास्त्रवित्तमः। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं विस्तेरण प्रकीर्तय॥
en: How was born his son Ashvathama, the foremost of all skilled in arms? I wish to hear all this. Narrate them in detail.

sa: तं दाशः प्रतिजग्राह विधिवत् प्रतिपूज्य च। अब्रवीचैनमासीनं राजसंसदि भारत॥
en: The fisherman received him with all due adorations. O descendant of the Bharata race, when the prince was seated, he addressed him thus-

sa: एतत् संस्कृत्य विधिवदन्नोपहितमाशु वै। तस्मै प्रादाद् ब्राह्मणाय क्षुधिताय तपस्विने॥
en: He washed it and then properly cooked it and then covering it with boiled rice, he gave it to the hungry ascetic Brahmana.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ततः सद्यस्तं प्राणैर्विप्रयुज्य च। शक्तिनं भक्षयामास व्याघ्रः पशुमिवेप्सितम्॥
en: Having said this, the king immediately killed Shakti and ate him up as a tiger eats up the animal it is fond of.

sa: नानीशैर्हि तदा तात भृगुभिर्भावितात्मभिः। वधो ह्युपेक्षितः सर्वैः क्षत्रियाणां विहिंसताम्॥
en: O child, it was not from incapacity that the self-controlled Bhrigus were all indifferent to their own destruction caused by the murderous Kshatriyas.

sa: उवाच स महातेजा ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम्। कृतं मयेदं भगवान्काव्यं परमपूजितम्॥
en: Then addressing Brahma, the greatly glorious Vyasa thus said: "O Divine Brahma, a poem, which is greatly respected, had been composed by me."

sa: दिवि देवा मुमुदिरे भूतसंघाश्च लौकिकाः। अग्निश्च परमां प्रीतिमवाप हतकल्मषः॥
en: The celestials in heaven and all creatures on earth were exceedingly rejoiced; and Agni too rejoiced, because he became free from the curse.

sa: तं दष्टं पन्नगेन्द्रेण करिष्येऽहमपज्वरम्। तत्र मेऽर्थश्च धर्मश्च भवितेति विचिन्तयन्॥
en: He thought, “I will cure the king bitten by the best of the snakes. By this I may gain both wealth and virtue."

sa: नानाराज्येषु च सुतान्स सम्राडभ्यषेचयत्। महारथो मागधानां विश्रुतो यो बृहद्रथः॥
en: The emperor (Vasu) installed his sons in many kingdoms. His illustrious son Brihadratha, a great car-warrior, was installed in the kingdom of Magadha.

sa: युष्माकं पूर्वको राजा सौदासस्तस्य भूपतेः। पुत्रो वीर्यसहो नाम वीर्यवानतिधार्मिकः॥
en: There was a king by the name of Saudāsa, one of your ancestors. His son Vīryasaha was a highly powerful and pious king.

sa: शशंस चैव भगवान् कालेनैतावता पुनः। उद्घाटनीयान्येतानि कुण्डानीति च सौबलीम्॥
en: The illustrious (Vyasa) then said to the daughter of Subala that she should open the covers of the jars after full two years.

sa: अयं बलवतां श्रेष्ठः कुन्तीपुत्रो वृकोदरः। मध्यमः पाण्डुपुत्राणां निकृत्या संनिगृह्यताम्॥
en: (He thought), the son of Kunti, this Vrikodara (Bhima, this second Pandava, is the foremost in strength, I must destroy him by artifice.

sa: तेन स्पृष्टो विपापस्त्वं भविता नरपुंगव। स्पृष्टो रामेण तच्छुत्वा नरेन्द्रः पृथिवीपतिः॥ गृध्रत्वं त्यक्तवानराजा दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनः। पुरुषो दिव्यरूपोऽभूदुवाचेदं च राघवम्॥ साधु राघव धर्मज्ञ त्वत्प्रसादादहं विभो। विमुक्तो नरकाद्धोराच्छापस्यान्तः कृतस्त्वया।॥
en: O foremost of men, you shall be released from the curse when he shall touch you.' Hearing the voice in the sky, Rāma touched Brahmadatta. Thereupon renouncing his venture from and assuming a beautiful body smeared with celestial perfumes, he praised Rāma and said: "O you conversant with piety, by your favour have I been saved from the dreadful hell—here has ended my curse."

sa: तस्यां रजन्यां व्युष्टायां कृत्वा पौर्वाणिकक्रमम्। उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं शत्रुघ्नो मुनिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: The night being over, he first went through the morning sites and then with folded hands addressed the foremost of ascetics, Valmiki, saying.

sa: तेषां पुत्रसहस्राणि बभूवुर्भुवि विस्तरः। द्वौ पुत्रौ ब्रह्मणस्त्वन्यौ ययोस्तिष्ठति लक्षणम्॥
en: These hundred sons begot offspring by thousands and filled the whole world. Brahma had two other sons, who had victory as their signification.

sa: भवतीति समाज्ञाय यत्नतः कार्यमुद्वहन्। स निश्चयार्थ कार्यस्य कृष्णमेव जनार्दनम्॥
en: Carefully bearing on his shoulder the weight of affairs, he (Yudhishthira) thought of Krishna Janardana as the fittest person to decide the matter.

sa: ततः पञ्चाशतं कन्या: पुत्रिका अभिसंदधे। प्रजापतिः प्रजा दक्षः सिसृक्षुर्जनमेजय॥
en: Janamejaya, the lord of creation Prajapati Daksha, from the desire of creating more creatures, begot fifty daughters. He made them all his Putrikas.

sa: कच्चिद् द्विषामविदितः प्रतिपन्नश्च सर्वदा। नित्ययुक्तो रिपून् सर्वान् वीक्षसे रिपुसूदन॥
en: O slayer of foes, do you watch your enemies with all possible care and attention and do you accomplish this unknown to them?

sa: ततो नावं परित्यज्य प्रययुर्दक्षिणां दिशम्। विज्ञाय निशि पन्थानं नक्षत्रगणसूचितम्॥
en: They then left the boat and proceeded towards the south, fin ding their way in the dark by the light of the stars.

sa: ससागर: सगगनः सशैल: सबलाहकः। सभूमिः साग्निपवनो लोकोऽयं केन निर्मितः॥
en: Bharadwaja said By whom was this world its ocean, its sky, its mountains, its clouds, its lands, its fire, and its wind, created?

sa: समुद्रं तरते दोभ्यां तत्र किं नाम पौरुषम्॥ अकृतास्त्रः कृतास्त्रं वै बलवन्तं सुदुर्बलः। तादृशं कर्ण यः पार्थं योद्धुमिच्छेत् स दुर्मतिः॥ अस्माभिर्वेष निकृतो वर्षाणीह त्रयोदश। सिंहः पाशविनिर्मुक्तो न नः शेषं करिष्यति॥ एकान्ते पार्थमासीनं कूपेऽग्निमिव संवृतम्। अज्ञानादभ्यवस्कन्ध प्राप्ताः स्मो भयमुत्तमम्॥ सह युध्यामहे पार्थमागतं युद्धदुर्मदम्।
en: Who, binding himself hand and foot and tying a huge stone to his neck, would wish to swim across the ocean with his bare arms? What manliness is there? O Karna, a fool is he, who, without strength and skill in arms, desires to fight with Partha who is so powerful and skilled in weapons? Oppressed by us and freed from thirteen years' exile, will he not destroy us like a lion liberated from the noose? Having unknowingly come to a place where Partha lay hidden like fire we have been exposed to a great danger. Although dreadful in battle we should fight against him.

sa: पाञ्चालस्य च दायादोधृष्टकेतुश्च चेदिपः। केकयाश्च महावीर्या भ्रातरो लोकविश्रुताः॥ वने द्रष्टुं ययुः पार्थान् क्रोधामर्षसमन्विताः। गर्हयन्तोधार्तराष्ट्रान् किं कुर्म इति चाब्रुवन्॥
en: The relatives of (the king) Panchala, Dhristadyumna, the king of Chedi and the greatly powerful and renowned brothers, the Kaikeyas. Went to see the sons of Pritha in the forest. Their heart inflamed with wrath, they reproaching the sons of Dhritarashtra said, “What should we do?”

sa: अदृश्यन्त महाराज महोल्का इव खाच्च्युताः। सा निशा भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रदीपैरवभासिता॥
en: Looked, O great king, like large meteors drooping from the firmament. O foremost of the Bharatas, that night blazed up by those lamps.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं रुद्रेण समुदाहृतम्। स्वपुरं पुनरागम्य सम्भारान् पुनरार्जयत्॥
en: Having heard these words of Rudra, the king returned to his capital and begin to collect all that were necessary for his sacrifice.

sa: तस्मिन् सारस्वते तीर्थे विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः। वसिष्ठं चालयामास तपसोगेण तच्छृणु॥
en: The great Rishi Vishvamitra, by the help of his austere penances, brought Vashishtha, to that tirtha of the Sarasvati, listen to that account.

sa: ते हन्यमाना वीरेण क्षत्रियाः कालचोदिताः। व्यसृजञ्छरजालानि पार्थे नानाविधानि च॥
en: Those Kshatriyas, doomed by fate to die, being smitten by the heroic son of Pritha, discharged at him a net-work of diverse arrows.

sa: मक्षिकादंशमशकान् सिंहान् व्याघ्रान् सरीसृपान्। प्राप्नोत्यनियतः पार्थ नियतस्तान् न पश्यति॥
en: O son of Pritha, the sinful men meet there flies, gad-flies, mosquitoes, tigers, lions and reptiles, but pure-souled men do not meet them.

sa: तं तथा भाषमाणं तु धर्मराजमरिंदमम्। नोवाच भगवान् किंचिद् ध्यानमेवान्वपद्यत॥
en: The divine Krishna did not speak a single word to that chastiser of enemies, king Yudhishthira, for he was then rapt in meditation.

sa: तांस्तथा व्याकुलीकृत्य त्वरमाणो धनंजयः। जघान निशितैर्बाणैः सहस्राणि शतानि च।॥
en: Thus causing great anxiety in them, Dhananjaya with great lightness of hands slew, with keen pointed shafts, hundreds and thousands of the enemy.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एवमुक्त्वा ततः श्रीमान्मन्त्रिभिश्चानुमोदितः। आरुरोह प्रतिज्ञां स सर्पसत्राय पार्थिवः॥
en: Sauti said : The illustrious king having said so, the ministers expressed their approbation. The king expressed his determination of performing a Snake-sacrifice.

sa: परिधान् भिंदिपालांश्च भुशुण्डी: कुणपानपि। अयस्कुन्तांश्च पतितान् मुसलानि गुरूणि च॥
en: (Again behold) the spiked maces, the short arrows, the Bhushandis, the Kanayas, the Kuntas, made of iron, scattered about and the huge musalas.

sa: प्रद्युम्नोऽयमुपायाति भीतस्त्यक्त्वा महाहवम्। धिगेनमिति वक्ष्यन्ति न तु वक्ष्यन्ति साध्विति॥
en: They will say "Here comes Pradyumna, the coward, running away from the great battle. Fie on him.” They will never say “Well done?”

sa: पतितः शोच्यते राजन् निर्धनश्चापि शोच्यते। विशेष नाधिगच्छामि पतितस्याधनस्य च॥
en: A degraded man as also a poor man, O king, have both to rue their fate, I see no difference between these two.

sa: तौ तथा तु महाराज गदाहस्तौ सुदुःसहौ। अन्योन्यं वाग्भिरुग्राभिस्तक्षमाणौ व्यवस्थितौ॥
en: Meanwhile those two heroes, O king, both armed with maces, and both unbearable by foes, stood there, exasperating each other with fierce speeches.

sa: प्रतिविन्ध्यो युधिष्ठिरात् सुतसोमो वृकोदरात्। अर्जुनाच्छ्रुतकीर्तिश्च शतानीकस्तु नाकुलिः॥ कनिष्ठाच्छुतकर्मा च सर्वे सत्यपराक्रमाः। प्रद्युम्नो यादृशः कृष्ण तादृशास्ते महारथाः॥
en: Prativindhya (was begotten) by Yudhishthira, Satasoma by Vrikodara (Bhima), Shrutakirti by Arjuna, Satanika by Nakula. Shrutakarman by the youngest (of my husbands) Sahadeva. They are all of irrepressible prowess. O Krishna, they are all as great car-warriors as Pradyumna (Krishna's son).

sa: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तेषां ब्राह्मणानां युधिष्ठिरः। गिरीशस्य यथान्यायमुपहार मुपाहरत्॥
en: Hearing these words of those Brahmanas, Yudhishthira caused offerings to be duly made to that deity who loved to lie down on mountain-breasts.

sa: ततः श्वेतहयः कृष्णमब्रवीदजितं जयः। एव मां भ्रातृभिः सार्धं सुशर्माऽऽह्वयतेऽच्युत॥
en: The invincible Arjuna owning white steeds then thus addressed Krishna Krishna saying:-'O Achyuta, this Susarman assisted by his brother challenges me (to fight).

sa: महता रथवंशेन परिगृह्य बलं महत्। बीभत्सुदक्षिणं पार्श्वमुत्तरं तु वृकोदरः॥
en: Attacked the large army (of Drona) with a mighty car force. Vibhatsu attacking the right and Vrikodara the left flank (of Drona's army).

sa: ये चेमे पृथवो दीर्घाश्चन्द्रबिम्बार्धदर्शनाः। एते भीमस्य निशिता रिपुक्षयकराः शराः॥
en: These sharp, long and heavy arrows, resembling the crescent of the moon in shape and capable of destroying the enemies, belong to Bhima.

sa: अनुस्मरन् वपुस्तस्य श्रियं चाप्रतिमां भुवि। माहात्म्यमनुभावं च स्मरन् दाशरथेर्ययौ॥
en: He went on, reflecting on Hanumana's body and effulgence which were matchless on earth and also the greatness and dignity of Dasharatha's son.

sa: चातुर्वर्यं स्वधर्मस्थं स कृत्वा पर्यरक्षत। धर्मतो धर्मविद्राजा धर्मो विग्रहवानिव॥
en: That virtuous king, virtuously inclined, protected, like Virtue and Justice themselves, the four castes, keeping them in the duties of their respective orders.

sa: षडिन्द्रियाणि विषयं समागच्छन्ति वै यदा। तदा प्रादुर्भवत्येषां पूर्वसंकल्पजं मनः॥
en: When any of the six senses finds its ! particular object, the desire springs up in the heart to enjoy that particular object.

sa: गालवस्त्वभ्यनुज्ञाय सुपर्णं पन्नगाशनम्। पितुर्निर्यात्य तां कन्यां प्रययौ वनमेव ह॥
en: Galava, then having permitted Suparna who subsisted on serpents to go away and returning the damsel to his father, went to the forest.

sa: सा दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवांस्तत्र सुप्तान् मात्रा सह क्षितौ हृच्छयेनाभिभूतात्मा भीमसेनमकामयत्॥
en: Seeing the Pandavas asleep on the ground with their mother and being influenced by desire, she sought to have Bhimasena as her lord.

sa: अमृतस्येव संतृप्यदेवमानस्य पण्डितः। सुखं ह्यवमतः शेते योऽवमन्ता स नश्यति॥
en: The wise and learned man considers revilement as nectar. Reviled, he sleeps without anxiety. The reviler, on the other hand, meets with destruction.

sa: दिष्ट्या ते भरतश्रेष्ठ समाप्तोऽयं महाक्रतुः। हतेषु युधि पार्थेषु राजसूये तथा त्वया॥ आहतेऽहं नरश्रेष्ठ त्वां सभाजयिता पुनः।
en: “O foremost of the Bharata race, by good luck you have completed the great sacrifice. When the Pandavas will be killed in battle and when you will thus complete Rajasuya sacrifice, then at that time again I shall thus honour you."

sa: कश्चिन्महति कान्तारे वर्तमानो द्विजः किल। महद् दुर्गमनुप्राप्तो वनं क्रव्यादसंकुलम्॥
en: A cretin Brahmana, living in the great world, found himself on one occasion in a large inaccessible forest abounding with beasts of prey.

sa: तथा तु रममाणस्य दिवोदासस्य भूपतेः। माधवी जनयामास पुत्रमेकं प्रतर्दनम्॥
en: As Rama with the princess of Videha and as Janardana with Rukmini. Then to the king of the earth, Divodasa, sporting with her,

sa: मतिमन्तो ह्यतो वैद्याः शमं प्रागेव कुर्वते। मानसस्य प्रियाख्यानैः सम्भोगोपनयैर्नृणाम्॥
en: Therefore, intelligent physicians first seek to allay the mental sufferings of their patients by agreeable conversations and by the offer of desirable objects.

sa: तत् समीक्ष्य ततः कर्णो ब्रह्मास्त्रेण धनंजयम्। अभ्यवर्षत् पुनर्यनमकरोद् रथसर्जने॥
en: Seeing it Karna invoked the Brahma weapon, shot arrows on Dhananjaya and tried once more to get rid of his car. arrOWS son

sa: निर्यातयतु मे कन्यां भवांस्तिष्ठन्तु वाजिनः। यावदन्यत्र गच्छामि शुल्कार्थं पृथिवीपते॥
en: When the proper time came, he said these words "Return me my maiden but let the horses remain with you for the present,

sa: यद् यत् यजति कामानां तत् सुखस्याभिपूर्यते। कामानुसारी पुरुषः कामाननुविनश्यति॥
en: If objects, of desire, are renounced they become sources of happiness. The man who follows objects of desire is ruined in that pursuit.

sa: यस्य ज्यातलनिर्घोषं विस्फूर्जितमिवाशनेः। न सेहे देवराजोऽपि तमस्मि मनसा गतः॥
en: My mind was fixed in him the twang of whose bow and the sound of whose palms Indra himself was unable to bear.

sa: प्रकृत्या घोररूपं तदासीद् घोरतरं पुनः। रात्रिश्च भरतश्रेष्ठ योधानां युद्धशालिनाम्॥
en: That night which was naturally of a terrible aspect became more dreadful, o best of the Bharatas, to the combatants engaged in battle.

sa: ततः स्वे गोचरे न्यस्य मनोबुद्धिन्द्रियाणि सः। स्मितपूर्वमुवाचेदं भगवान् वासवानुजः॥
en: Thus accosted the illustrious younger brother of Vasava, reinstating his mind, understanding and the senses in their proper places, said these words similingly.

sa: बृहस्पति रुवाच प्रतिमेहन्ति ये सूर्यमनिलं द्विषते च ये। हव्यवाहे प्रदीप्ते च समिधं ये न जुह्वति॥ बालवत्सां च ये धेनुं दुहन्ति क्षीरकारणात्। तेषां दोषान् प्रवक्ष्यामि तान् निबोध शचीपते॥
en: Brihaspati said They who pass urine, facing the sun, they who do not show respect for the wind, they who do not pour libations on the burning fire, they who milk a cow whose calf is very young, actuated by the desire of obtaining from her as much milk as possible, commit many sins. I shall describe what those faults are, O lord of Shachi, Do you hear me.

sa: पृष्ठतः परिवर्तन्त्या पश्चिमं निःसृतं सुखम्। गतया चोत्तरं पार्श्वमुत्तरं निःसृतं मुखम्॥ महेन्द्रस्यापि नेत्राणां पृष्ठतः पार्श्वतोऽग्रतः। रक्तान्तानां विशालानां सहस्रं सर्वतोऽभवत्॥
en: When she came behind him, another face appeared on his western side; and when she came on the northern side, a fourth face appeared on his northern side. Indra also came to have one thousand eyes before, behind and on his flanks, each large and reddish.

sa: संजय उवाच तेषां नूनं भयान्नासौ कृतवान् कुरुनन्दन। असांनिध्याद्धि पार्थानां केशवस्य च धीमतः॥ सात्यकेश्चापि कर्मेदं द्रोणपुत्रेण साधितम्।
en: Sanjaya said "Through fear of the Parthas, O descendant of Kuru, Ashvatthaman could not perform such a fear then! It was for the absence of the Partha and the intelligent Keshava as also of Satyaki, that Drona's son could achieve it.

sa: बृहन्नलोवाच यन्मां पूर्वमिहापृच्छः शत्रुसेनापहारिणम्। गाण्डीवमेतत् पार्थस्य लोकेषु विदितं धनुः॥
en: Brihannala said The one about which you first enquired is the world-wide known Gandiva bow of Arjuna, capable of destroying the enemy's army.

sa: मुख्यश्चैवैष नो धर्मः क्षत्रियाणां जनार्दन। यच्छयीमहि संग्रामे शरतल्पगता वयम्॥
en: The principal duty of ours, Kshatriyas, O Janardana, is that we should lie down on a bed of arrows in the battle field.

sa: आनुपूर्व्यानिषेदुश्च सर्वे मन्त्रिपुरोहिताः। ततः सेनापतिः पश्चात् प्रशास्ता च न्यषीदत॥
en: Then the counsellors and priests seated themselves according to rank. And thereafter the general and the protector of the encampment (got themselves seated).

sa: नाशुक्लवासास्तत्रासीत् क्षुधितो मलिनोऽपि वा। रजसा ध्वस्तकेशो वा नरः कश्चिददृश्यत॥
en: And there appeared no one who wore a soiled habit, or who was hungry, or melancholy, or whose hair was covered with dust.

sa: द्वौ च खङ्गौ च पार्श्वस्थौ प्रदीपौ पार्श्वशोभितौ। चतुर्हस्तत्सरुचितौ व्यक्तहस्तदशायतौ॥
en: There are (in that car) two effulgent swords at iis side, illumining it, their hafts measuring four lands and their blades ten each.

sa: ततस्तत्परितो याता निरपेक्षा निशाचराः। पुरीमभिमुखा भीता द्रवन्तो नायके हते॥
en: On their leader having been slain, those nightrangers that were about (Atikāya), without waiting any longer, overwhelmed with panic, rushed towards the city.

sa: तत् तथेत्यब्रवीद् रामः सुग्रीवं प्रियवादिनम्। लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो लक्ष्म्या वासवस्येव धीमतः॥
en: There at the graceful Rāma, in front of the intelligent Lakşmaņa resembling Väsava, said to Sugriva of a pleasing presence,-It is even so.

sa: बलवान् हि ममामर्षः श्रुत्वा त्वामवमानितम्। वर्धते हृदयोत्कम्पी प्रावृड्वेग इवाम्भसः॥
en: Great is my wrath, on hearing you disgraced; and like a down-pour in the rainy season my ire increases, shaking my very heart.

sa: अद्य रामं ससुग्रीवं परिघेण सलक्ष्मणम्। आगमिष्यामि हत्वैको विक्षोब्य हरिवाहिनीम्॥
en: This very day, staying single-handed Rāma with Sugrīva and with Lakşmaņa, with this bludgeon shall I return, after having sorely troubled the monkey-host.

sa: ततो विष्णोश्चतुर्भागमागतं सुरसत्तमाः। हृष्टाः प्रमुदिताः सर्वे पूजयन्ति स्म राघवम्॥
en: There upon beholding Lakşmaņa, the fourth portion of Vişnu arrived at their city the celestials were greatly delighted and engaged in his worship.

sa: कौसल्यानन्तरं राज्ञः सुमित्रा तदनन्तरम्। न स्म विभ्राजते देवी शोकाश्रुलुलितानना॥
en: After Kausalyā, the king, and after him, Sumitrā; and with her countenance faded from grief this noble lady did not look particularly lovely.

sa: अद्य ते मच्छरैश्छिन्नं शिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम्। क्रव्यादा व्यपकर्षन्तु विकीर्णं रणपांसुषु॥
en: Today beasts of pray will drag your head having burning ear-rings, severed by my shafts and covered with the dust of the battle-field.

sa: अग्नेस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा पितृदेवाः समागताः। उत्पाट्य मेषवृषणौ सहस्राक्षे न्येवशयन्॥
en: ram Hearing Agni's speech, the assembled Pitrs, rooting up the scrotum of the ram, joined it to the person of the thousand-eyed deity.

sa: त्वं गच्छारिष्टमव्यग्रः पन्थानमकुतोभयम्। प्रशाधि राज्यं धर्मेण गतिहि जगतो भवान्॥
en: Kākutstha, do you now go with ease and fearlessly, and govern your kingdom righteously. O Rāma you are the refuge of the world.

sa: अनर्थिनः सुताः स्त्रीणां भर्तारो भ्रातरस्तथा। सर्वे सर्वं परित्यज्य राममेवान्वचिन्तयन्॥
en: Sons depend not upon their parents, husbands on their wives, and brothers on brothers, and all forsaking each other, think of Rāma only.

sa: श्रुत्वा तूशनसो वाक्यं सोऽश्रमावसथो जनः। निषक्रान्तो विषयात्तस्मात्स्थानं चक्रेऽथ बाह्यतः॥
en: Hearing the words of the preceptor Sukra, the inmates left the hermitage and lived at a place beyond the limit of Danda's territories.

sa: ततोऽन्तराणि सत्त्वानि खादते स महाबलः। संहारे समनुप्राप्ते व्यादितास्य इवान्तकः॥
en: And like the Destroyer on the occasion of the universal dissolution, that one possessed of gigantic strength feeds on other creatures as well.

sa: प्रसृतः सर्वगात्रेभ्यः स्वेदं शोकाग्निसम्भवम्। यथा सूर्यांशुसंतप्तो हिमवान् प्रसृतो हिमम्॥
en: Perspiration produced by the fire of sorrow issued out of all his limbs, as the Himavat heated by the solar warmth generates water.

sa: काचिदङ्के शिरः कृत्वा रुरोद मुखमीक्षती। स्नापयन्ती मुखं बाष्पैस्तुषारैरिव पङ्कजम्॥
en: And some placing her head on his lap, and beholding his face, wept, bathing it with tears like a lotus enveloped with snow.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा दुःखितं सर्वं जनं तमुपजीविनम्। उवाचेदं धनाध्यक्षं धनमानीयतां मम॥
en: Having spoken thus to all those dependants who were racked with great sorrow, Rāma ordered the Treasury officer to bring his riches there.

sa: ब्रवीमि सत्येन न ते स्म यन्त्रणां धनं हि यद्यन्मम विप्रकारणात्। भवत्सु सम्यकप्रतिपादनेन मयार्जितं चैव यशस्करं भवेत्॥
en: Truly do I speak that you should not hesitate. I am ready to devote my wealth to the services of the Brāhmanas. And the wealth I have earned will conduce to my favour, if I can apply it to your service.

sa: त्रयस्त्रिंशच्च वै देवास्तथा वैमानिका गणाः। सोपेन्द्राः समहेन्द्राश्च त्वामिष्ट्वा सिद्धिमागताः॥
en: Thirty three gods, with Upendra (Vishnu) and Mahendra (Indra) and the Vaimanikas (an order of celestials) have all attained success by worshipping you.

sa: यस्तु मे देवविहितो भक्षः क्षत्रियपुङ्गव। तमुत्सृज महीपाल कपोतमिममेव मे॥
en: O ruler of earth, O best of Kshatriyas, give me therefore this pigeon which is the food ordained to me by the celestials.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तच्छ्रुत्वा तापसवचः पाण्डुश्चिन्तापरोऽभवत्॥ आत्मनो मृगशापेन जानन्नुपहतां क्रियाम्। सोऽब्रवीद् विजने कुन्ती धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनीम्। अपत्योत्पादने यत्नमापदि त्वं समर्थय॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard these words of the ascetics and remembering the loss of his procreative power owing to the curse of the deer, Pandu began to reflect. He told his lawfully wedded wife, illustrious Kunti, in private, “Try to raise offspring at this emergency.

sa: ततो जयो महाराज कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः। काम्बोजश्च श्रुतायुश्च धनञ्जयमवारयन्॥
en: Thereupon, O mighty monarch, Jaya, Kritavarman of the Satva race and the Kamboja king the Shrutayusha-these put themselves on the way of Dhananjaya.

sa: स तत्कुणपदुर्गन्धमशिवं लोमहर्षणम्। जगाम राजा धर्मात्मा मध्ये बहु विचिन्तयन्॥
en: Along that path so disagreeable with the stench of corpses and awful with other incidents, the righteous-souled king went filled with various thoughts.

sa: भो भो धर्मज राजर्षे पुण्याभिजन पाण्डव। अनुग्रहार्थमस्माकं तिष्ठ तावन्मुहूर्तकम्॥
en: O son Dharma, O royal sage, O you of holy birth, o son of Pandu, do you say a moment of favouring us.

sa: एवं स सुबहून् मल्लान् पुरुषांश्च महाबलान्। विनिघ्नन् मत्स्यराजस्य प्रीतिमाहरदुत्तमाम्॥
en: Having thus slain numerous athletes and many other persons of great strength he received the great favour of the king of the Matsya's.

sa: अथापरेण भल्लेन सुयुक्तेनाशुपातिना। दुष्कर्णं सुदृढं क्रुद्धो विव्याध हृदये भृशम्॥
en: Then highly excited with rage, he in that conflict, deeply pierced, Dushkarna on the chest with another broad-headed arrow welldirected and swift coursing.

sa: कच्चिद् गाण्डीवशब्देन न प्रणश्यति वैबलम्। यद्वः सभैरवं कुर्वन्नर्जुनो भृशमन्वयात्॥
en: Did Arjuna rush to battle, killing your warriors by the very twang of his bow Gandiva and achieving dreadful feat (as he advanced).

sa: तरुणस्तरुणप्रज्ञः सौभद्रः परवीरहा। यदाभ्यधावद्वै द्रोणं तदाऽऽसीद् वो मनः कथम्॥
en: What heroes surrounded him when he advanced towards Drona? That youthful hero of unripe understanding, that slayer of hostile heroes, namely Subhadra's son.

sa: कृसनं शतपथं चैव प्रणेष्यसि द्विजर्षभ। तस्यान्ते चापुनर्भावे बुद्धिस्तव भविष्यति॥
en: You will also edit the entire Satapathas, O foremost of twice-born ones. After that, your understanding will turn to the path of Liberation.

sa: ततः सत्यजितश्चापं छित्वा द्रोणोवृकस्य च। षभिः ससूतं सहयंशरैर्दोणोऽवधीद् वृकम्॥
en: Thereafter Drona, having cut asunder the bows of Satyajit and Vrika, killed the latter along with his driver and horses, with six shafts.

sa: ततो राजानमासाद्य प्रहरन्तमभीतवत्। अविध्यन्नवभिः क्षेमं स हतः प्रापतद् रथात्॥
en: Then getting near king Kshema, who was fighting fearlessly, Drona pierced him with nine arrows and he fell down dead from his chariot.

sa: गुणस्वभावस्त्वव्यक्तो गुणान् नैवातिवर्तते। उपयुङ्क्ते च तानेव स चैवाज्ञः स्वभावतः॥
en: Unmanifest Nature is by her nature endued with qualities. She cannot transcends them. Shorn of intelligence by nature she becomes attached to qualities.

sa: सततं निरयं प्राप्ताः परपिण्डोपजीविनः। न भवेम यता राजंस्तथा नीतिविधीयताम्॥
en: Becoming defendants on others for our food, we shall suffer perpetual distress. O king, therefore, adopt such counsel that is consonant with statesmanship.

sa: ततो द्वितीये दिवसे महाशब्दो व्यवर्धत॥ आगच्छति नरव्याघ्ने कौरवाणां धुरंधरे।
en: On the second day forin that date, a loud din was heard when that foremost of men, tha chief of the Kurus camc.

sa: द्वितीयश्चापि मे मासो जलं भक्षयतो गतः। निराहारस्तृतीयेऽथ मासे पाण्डवनन्दन॥
en: (And), O son of Pandu, I spent the second month living on water only and in the third I ate nothing at all.

sa: अनु तस्यापरं भूतं महत् कैरातसंस्थितम्। धनुर्बाणासिमत् प्राप्तं स्त्रीगणानुगतं तदा॥
en: He was followed by another great being, in the shape of a hunter, armed with bow, arrows and sword and accompanied by females.

sa: स तु मामब्रवीद् राजन् मम पूर्वपरिग्रहः। मृगयाधर्ममुत्सृज्य किमर्थं ताडितस्त्वया॥
en: And he said to me, O King, "why have you, disregarding the rules of hunting aimed at the animal first struck by me?

sa: प्रसमीक्ष्य भवानेतद् वक्तुमर्हति केशव। मामेव हि विशेषेण विभाष्य परिगर्हसे॥
en: "It is proper, that you should speak to me in this way after due consideration; but you speak, finding fault with me especially.

sa: तस्य सर्वे महीपाला धनान्याजह्वराज्ञया। द्विजानां परिवेष्टारस्तस्मिन् यज्ञे च तेऽभवन्॥
en: All the monarchs at his command brought wealth to that sacrifice. They became the distributors of food to the Brahmanas in that sacrifice.

sa: एतस्मात् कारणाद् राजन् हरिश्चन्द्रो विराजते। तेभ्यो राजसहस्रेभ्यस्तद् विद्धि भरतर्षभा॥
en: O king, O best of the Bharata race, know that for this reason, Harishchandra has shone more brightly than thousands of other kings.

sa: अन्योन्यं परिमुष्णान्तो हिंसयन्तश्च मानवाः। अजपा नास्तिका: स्तेना भविष्यन्ति युगक्षये॥
en: At the end of Yuga men will be opposed to one another and seek one another's life. They will be atheists and thieves.

sa: जीवितान्तकरा: क्रूरा रौद्राः प्राणिविहिंसकाः। यदा भविष्यन्ति नरास्तदा संक्षेप्स्यते युगम्॥
en: When men will kill others, when they will be wicked, cruel and destroyers of all animals, then will that (Kali) Yuga would come,

sa: सम्भूतः सम्भलग्रामे ब्राह्मणावसथे शुभे। मनसा तस्य सर्वाणि वाहनान्यायुधानि च॥ उपस्थास्यन्ति योधाश्च शस्त्राणि कवचानि च। सधर्मविजयी राजा चक्रवर्ती भविष्यति॥
en: He will be born at a village called Sambhala in a blessed Brahmana family. As soon as thought of, vehicles, weapons, warriors and arms and armours will all be at his command. He will be the imperial sovereign ever victorious by the strength of his virtue.

sa: छिन्नधन्वा महाराज सात्यकिः क्रोधमूर्छितः। प्रजहार महावेगां शक्तिं तस्य महोरसि॥
en: Ogreat king, his bow being (thus) cut-off, Satyaki, insensible with wrath, hurled an impetuous dart at the broad chest of that (Kuru hero).

sa: स तु शक्त्या विभिन्नाङ्गो निपपात रथोत्तमात्। लोहिताङ्ग इवाकाशाद् दीप्तरश्मिर्यदृच्छया॥
en: His body being riven by that dart, he fell down from his excellent car like the blazing Mars (dropping down) from the firmament.

sa: सुभिक्षाश्चैव पञ्चालाः श्रूयन्ते शत्रुकर्शन। यज्ञसेनश्च राजासौ ब्रह्मण्य इति शुश्रुम॥
en: O destroyer of foes, we have heard that alms are easily obtainable in Panchala and the king Yajnasena is devoted to the Brahmanas.

sa: पुनश्चापि महाकायः संछिन्नः शतधा रणे॥ गतसत्त्वो निरुत्साहः पतितः खाद्ध्यदृश्यत।
en: Soon again, the huge Rakshasas with hundred of wounds on his body seemed to lie cheerlessly and like one dead, on the field.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा रोषाताम्राक्षं रक्षः क्रूरपराक्रमम्॥ उत्पपातान्तरिक्षं च जहास च सुविस्तरम्।
en: Having thus spoken, the Rakshasa of fierce prowess, with his eyes red in rage, soared into the sky and laughed a tremendous laugh.

sa: आगम्यागम्य चैवेनं भूयोभूयोऽवहस्य च। शतक्रतुरनिर्विण्णं पृष्ट्वा पृष्ट्वा जगाम ह॥
en: Shakra repeatedly come to him and repeatedly receiving the same reply went away and ridiculed him. Kuru, however, was not at all depressed.

sa: स दुष्टः पापमाशंसुः पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। अनामन्त्र्यैव तान् विप्नांस्तमुवाच महीपतिम्॥
en: That wicked Rakshasa, desirous of doing evil to the high-souled Pandavas, and without having consulted those Brahmanas, said these words to the king.

sa: अत्र राज्येन विप्राणां चन्द्रमाश्चाभ्यषिच्यत। अत्र गङ्गां महादेवः पतन्तीं गगनाच्च्युताम्॥
en: Here was the moon entrusted with the kingship over regenerate persons and here Mahadeva let fall the Ganga, which descended from the sky,

sa: व्यालतस्करसंकीर्णे सार्थहीना यथा वने॥ तथा त्वदीया निहते सूतपुत्रे तदाभवन्।
en: After the fall of the Suta's son, your troops became like straggling travellers in a forest abounding with robbers and beasts of prey.

sa: मुनेरपि वनस्थस्य स्वानि कर्माणि कुर्वतः॥ उत्पाद्यन्ते त्रयः पक्षा मित्रोदासीनशत्रवः।
en: Even for an ascetic living in the forest and engaged in his own acts, there are three parties, viz., friends, neutrals, and foes.

sa: यदहंकारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे। मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति॥
en: If out of self-conceit you think “I will not fight,” your this resolution will be in vain, for surely will Nature rule you.

sa: स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा। कर्तुनेच्छसि यन्मोहात् करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत्॥
en: Bound by your own Duty, ordained by Nature, you will involuntarily do not, which, out of delusion, you do not wish to do.

sa: कर्णोऽपि दृष्ट्वा द्रवतो धार्तराष्ट्रान् सराजकान्। पद्रराजमुवाचेदं याहि भीमरथं प्रति॥
en: Beholding the army of Dhritarashtra, with all the kings flying Karna said to the king of Madras. "Proceed towards the car of Bhima."

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुः प्रायादाधिरथिं प्रति। सिंहनादेन महता सर्वाः संनादयन् दिशः॥
en: Having said these words and made all the quarters resound with a loud and leonine shout the mighty-armed Bhima proceeded towards Adhiratha's son.

sa: अथ कर्णः शरव्रातैर्भीमसेनं समार्पयत्। ननाद च महानादं पुनर्विव्याध चोरसि॥
en: Thereupon Karna covered Bhima with mriyads of shafts and then uttered a loud warcry and once more pierced the latter on his breast.

sa: न्यविशन्त हि ते सर्वे निरास्वादे महावने। ततस्तृषापरिक्लान्ता कुन्ती पुत्रानथाब्रवीत्॥
en: They then sat down in that great forest without food or water and Kunti, afflicted with thirst, then spoke thus to her sons-

sa: रक्षार्थं सर्वभूतानां विष्णुत्वमुपजग्मिवान्। त्वद्वीर्यनिहते वृत्रे वासवो ब्रह्महत्यया।॥ वृतः सुरगणश्रेष्ठ मोक्षं तस्य विनिर्दिशा तेषां तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा देवानां विष्णुरब्रवीत्॥
en: You assumed the form of Vishnu for protecting all the beings. Vritra being slain through (the aid of) your strength, Vasava, the chief among all the gods, is overpowered by the sin of slaying a Brahmana. Indicate to us the means of his salvation. Vishnu, having

sa: श्येनागृध्राश्च काकाश्च कङ्काश्च सहिता बकैः। सम्पतन्ति नगाग्रेषु समवायांश्च कुर्वते॥
en: Hawks and vultures and crows and herons and cranes are coming down on the top of trees and are assembling in great numbers.

sa: ततः सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य तावकस्य विशाम्पते। सिंहनादो महानासीद्धतं मत्वा धनंजयम्॥
en: Thereupon, O ruler of men, a loud and deafening roar was uttered by all your troops, for they considered Dhananjaya to be slain.

sa: संछन्नं शरजालेन रथं दृष्ट्वा सकेशवम्। शत्रु चाभिमुखौ दृष्ट्वा दीप्यमानाविवानलौ॥
en: Saw his chariot and Keshava shrouded with a net-work of arrows; then beholding his two opponents standing before him like two blazing fires.

sa: श्रुतायुषं च निहतं प्रेक्ष्य चैवाच्युतायुषम्। नियतायुश्च संक्रुद्धो दीर्घायुश्चैव भारत॥ पुत्रौ तयोर्नरश्रेष्ठौ कौन्तेयं प्रतिजग्मतुः। किरन्तोविविधान् बाणान् पितृव्यसनकर्शितौ॥
en: Beholding Shrutayusha slain, O Bharata, the enraged Niyutayush and Dirghayusha, the sons of the former two heroes both foremost of men, assaulted the son of Kunti, afflicted with calamity that had befallen their sires they proceeded, scattering arrows of diverse description.

sa: चुक्रुशुश्च निपेतुश्च बभ्रमुश्चापरे दिशः। भृशं त्रस्ताश्व बहवः स्वानेव प्रमृदुर्गजाः॥
en: Or uttered yells of agony, or fell down or careered wildly in all directions. Numerous other elephants greatly frightened, crushed their own ranks.

sa: उपक्षेपणजोऽधर्मः सुमहान् स्यान्महीपतेः। यद्यस्य रुदतां द्वारि न करोम्यद्य रक्षणम्॥
en: If I do not protect him who is weeping at our gate, the king (Yudhishthira) will be touched by sin for my indifference.

sa: एताश्चान्याश्च विविधाः शल्यभूता नराधिपः॥ वृकोदरस्य ता वाचः श्रुत्वा निर्वेदमागमत्।
en: Hearing these and many other words, O king, of Vrikodara, which were so many darts, king Dhritarashtra gave way to cheerlessness and sorrow.

sa: यस्य शङ्खस्य नादेन भूतानि प्रचकम्पिरे। सभा च सा महाराज शातकुम्भमयदुमा॥ दशकिष्कुसहस्राणि समन्तादायताभवत्। यथा वह्नर्यथार्कस्य सोमस्य च यथा सभा॥ भ्राजमाना तथात्यर्थं दधार परमं वपुः। अभिघ्नतीव प्रभया प्रभामर्कस्य भास्वराम्॥
en: The sound of that conch used to make all creatures tremble in feat. O great king, the assembly-hall that Maya built, stood on golden pillars, and it occupied an area of five thousand cubits square, possessing an most beautiful form. It (the liall) shone in great splendour like the fire, the sun or the moon. By its great effulgence it seemed to darken even the rays of the sun.

sa: तेषां समुपविष्टानां देवानामिव संनये। आचख्यौ चेष्टितं जिष्णोः सभापाल: सहानुगः॥
en: When they were all seated like an assembly of celestials, the Sabhapala with his followers narrated all about the conduct of Jishnu (Arjuna).

sa: नागेष्वश्वेषु बहुशो रथेषु च परीक्षितम्। परीक्ष्य च यथान्यायं वेतनेनोपपादितम्॥
en: They have before been examined in the management of steeds, elephants and cars; and after due examination, they have been employed on pay.

sa: ततः क्रुद्धो रणे राजन् हृदिकस्यात्मसम्भवः। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन याज्ञसेनिं महारथम्॥
en: Then, O king, the son of Hridika, excited with wrath, in that battle, quickly rushed upon that mighty car-warrior that son of Yajnasena.

sa: च्यवनस्याश्रमं गत्वा पुण्यं द्विजनिषेवितम्। फलमूलाशनानां हि मुनीनां भक्षितं शतम्॥
en: Going to the sacred hermitage hermitage of Chayavana, frequented by the Brahmanas, they devoured one hundred Rishis who lived on fruits and roots.

sa: तेऽब्रुवन् नास्ति ते वीर्यं यत् एवं प्रभाषसे। सर्वास्त्वद्याभिगच्छन्तु स्कन्दं लोकस्य मातरः॥ कामवीर्या जन्तु चैनं तथेत्युक्त्वा च ता ययुः।
en: They (the celestial) said, “You have no heroism in you, therefore you speak thus. Let the mothers of the universe go today to Skanda. They can muster at will any power they like. Let them kill this child. Saying, “So be it,” they (mothers) went away.

sa: शरा दश दिशो मुक्ता वृषसेनेन संयुगे। विचेरुस्ते विनिर्भिद्य नरवाजिरथद्विपान्॥
en: In that battle numerous shafts discharged by Vrishasena flew in all the ten directions of the compass, piercing men, horses, cars and elephants.

sa: यान्ति चैवापरिक्लिष्टा नराः सस्यप्रदायकाः। नराः सुखतरं यान्ति विमानेषु गृहप्रदाः॥
en: Those that have given grains go along without being afflicted with any want; and those that have given houses go along on cars.

sa: सर्वोश्च ताननुययौ यावदावसथान् प्रति। स्वयमेव महातेजा दम्भं त्यक्त्वा युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: King Yudhishthira of great energy, renouncing all pride, himself followed all his guests to the pavilions that had been assigned for this residence.

sa: तस्मादस्माभिरप्यत्र दैत्याः शतसहस्रशः। नियुक्ता राक्षसाश्चैव ये ते संशप्तका इति॥
en: We have therefore appointed hundreds upon hundreds and thousands upon thousand of Daityas and Rakshasas; they are known by the name of Samshaptakas.

sa: निर्विद्यमानः सुभृशं भूयो वक्ष्यामि शाश्वतम्। भूयश्चैवाभिरक्षन्तु निर्धनान् निर्जना इव॥
en: I am overwhelmed with despair. I, therefore, repeat my promises. I pray you to protect me like sages who always protect the poor.

sa: अभिपन्नस्तु राजेन्द्र साम्बो वृष्णिकुलोद्बहः। वेगं वेगवतो राजस्तस्थौ वीरो विधारयन्॥
en: O king of kings, thus attacked the heroic Samba, the perpetuator of the Vrishni race, withstanding the attack of Vegavan, kept his ground.

sa: ततः सुतुमुलं युद्धं चारुदेष्णविविध्ययोः। वृत्रवासवयो राजन् यथा पूर्वं तथाभवत्॥
en: O king, the battle between Charudeshna and Vivindha was as fierce as that in the days of yore between Vitra and Vasava (Indra).

sa: स वध्यमानः समरे भारद्वाजेन सात्यकिः। नान्वपद्यत कर्तव्यं किञ्चदेव विशाम्पते॥
en: Thus repeatedly wounded by Bharadvaja's son in battle, O ruler of men, Satyaki could not decide as to what he should then do.

sa: तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण स्वाध्यायेन महर्षयः। विमुच्य देहांस्ते यान्ति मृत्योरविषयं गताः॥
en: By penances, by Brahmacharya, by study, the great Rishis, casting off their bodies, go to regions which are above the power of Death.

sa: महेन्द्रं वै गिरिश्रेष्ठं रामो नित्यमुपास्ति ह। ऋषयो वेदविद्वांसो गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा।।
en: Rama ever dwells on that highest among the mountains, called Mahendra. Rishis conversant with the Vedas and Gandharavas and Apsaras also live there.

sa: संछाद्यमानः कर्णेन बहुधा पाण्डुनन्दनः॥ चिच्छेद चापं कर्णस्य मुष्टिदेशे महारथः।
en: Thus although shrouded by Karna on all sides, that mighty car-warrior that son of Pandu, cut-off the bow of Karna near his grasp.

sa: क्रुद्धस्य तस्य स्रोताभ्यः कर्णादिभ्ये नराधिप। सधूमः सस्फुलिङ्गज्रिर्चः पावकः समजायत॥
en: O king, fire with smokes, sparks and flames began to issue out of his ears and other senses, so much angry he became.

sa: एतदस्त्रबलं रामे कार्तवीर्ये धनंजये॥ भीष्मे च पुरुषव्याघ्र यदिदं सात्वतां वरे। तं चास्य मनसा द्रोणः पूजयामास विक्रमम्॥
en: Achieved by Yuyudhana, O king-'This force of weapon that I see in this foremost of the Satvata race is possible only in Rama, in Kartavirya, in Dhananjaya and in Bhishma'. So, Drona praised the prowess of that hero in his mind.

sa: ननु नामाङ्कमारोप्य स्नेहाद् ग्रामान्तरं गताः। मूर्ध्नि पुत्रानुपाघ्राय प्रतिनन्दन्ति मानवाः॥
en: Men, going to places remote from their homes, take up other men's sons on their laps and smelling their heads, feel great happiness.

sa: मेनका त्रिदशेष्वेव त्रिदशाश्चानु मेनकाम्। ममैवोद्रिच्यते जन्म दुष्यन्त तव जन्मनः॥
en: Menaka is a celestial, (nay) Menaka is considered to be the best of celestial. O Dushyanta, my birth is noble than your own.

sa: प्रेक्षसे वर्मसंछन्नान् किरातैः समधिष्ठितान्। किरातराजो यान् प्रादाद् द्विरदान् सव्यसाचिनः॥ स्वलंकृतांस्तदा प्रेष्यानिच्छञ्जीवितमात्मनः। आसन्नेते पुरा राजस्व कर्मकरा दृढम्॥
en: That you can see, all covered with armours, ridden by Kiratas and adorned with ornaments, were formerly presented by the king of the Kiratas, together with many servants, to Savyasachin; O King these were at first engaged in doing your good.

sa: भीष्म उवाच समागतस्य रामेण पुनरेवातिदारुणम्। अन्येधुस्तुमुलं युद्धं तदा भरतसत्तम॥
en: Bhishma said O best among the Bharatas, the next day a hard and terrible fight took place with Rama who had come back.

sa: वृतः सुमहता राजन् बलेन चतुरङ्गिणा। आजगाम पुनर्वीरः शक्रप्रस्थं पुरोत्तमम्॥
en: O king, surrounded by a large army of the four kinds of troops, the hero (at last) returned to the city of Indraprastha.

sa: तानानुपूर्व्याद् भगवान् वधे मातुरचोदयत्। न च ते जातसंस्नेहाः किंचिदूचुर्विचेतसः॥
en: The exalted Rishi one after the other asked them to kill their mother. But they were confounded and could not utter a word.

sa: देवाः सर्वे नरव्याघ्र बृहस्पतिपुरोगमाः॥ ज्वलनं तं समासाद्य प्रीताऽभूवन् सवासवाः।
en: The celestials, O foremost of kings, with Brihaspati at their head, having found out the god, became very glad with Vasava amongst them.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजाः सर्वान् भ्रातृन् युधिष्ठिरः। श्रुतं वै पुरुषव्याघ्रा यन्मां द्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon, the greatly effulgent Yudhishthira thus spoke to all his brothers. "O best of men, you have heard what Dvaipayana (Vyasa) has said.

sa: कृत्वा मूत्रमुपस्पृश्य संध्यामन्वास्त नैषधः। अकृत्वा पादयोः शौचं तत्रै कलिराविशत्॥
en: Naishadha, after having with water, rinsed his mouth, performed the Sandhya ceremony, without having previously washed his two feet. Thereupon Kali possessed him.

sa: ततः पुण्ड्राधिपं वीरं वासुदेवं महाबलम्। कौशिकीकच्छनिलयं राजानं च महौजसम्॥
en: O king, he then subjugated the heroic and greatly powerful Vasudeva, the king of Pundra, and the king Mahaujasa who lived in Kaushikacha.

sa: एवमुक्तः स गन्धर्वैः कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः। गन्धर्वान् पुनरेवेदं वचनं प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: Having been thus addressed by the Gandharvas in these words, the son of Kunti, Dhananjaya, thus replied to the Gandharvas in these words,

sa: यस्मिन् यज्ञे हि भूर्दत्ता कश्यपाय महात्मने। सपर्वतवनोद्देशा दक्षिणार्थे स्वयम्भुवा॥
en: In which sacrifices the self-create (Brahma) gave away to the illustrious Kashyapa, as Dakshina, this earth with all its mountains, rivers and countries.

sa: स मुहूर्तं तथा भूत्वा सचेताः पुनरुत्थितः। रुधिरेणाप्लुताङ्गस्तु पाण्डवो भृशदुःखितः॥
en: He soon however regained consciousness. Rising up from the ground, his body being covered with blood, the Pandava (Arjuna) becanie overwhelmed with sorrow

sa: इयं पौरववंशस्य जननी मुदितेति ह। त्वामहं दृष्टवांस्तत्र विज्ञायोत्फुल्ललोचनः॥ न मामर्हसि कल्याणि अन्यथाध्यातुमप्सरः। गुरोर्गुरुतरा मे त्वं मम त्वं वंशवर्धिनी॥
en: I gazed at you with wide expanded eyes in delight, thinking, “This is the mother of the Puru dynasty." O blessed one, O Apsara, you should not entertain any other feeling towards me, for you are superior to my superior, you are perpetuator of my race.

sa: मृत्युरस्य महाबाहो रणे देवकिनन्दनः। कृष्णः संकल्पितोधात्रा तन्मिथ्या न भवेदिति॥
en: "O mighty-armed hero, the creator has ordained that he will be killed by Krishna, the son of Devaki. Let it not be falsified."

sa: पतींश्च द्रौपदी सर्वान् द्विजातींश्च यशस्विनी। मातृवद् भोजयित्वाचे शिष्टमाहारयत् तदा॥
en: The famous Draupadi first supplied her husband and the Brahmanas with food like their mother and at last she took her food herself.

sa: सिंहनादभयत्रस्तैः कुञ्जरैरपि भारत। मुक्तो विरावः सुमहान् पर्वतो येन पूरितः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, being frightened by the yelling of the lions, the elephants also sent forth tremendous roars which filled the mountain.

sa: यदि जानीत नृपतिं क्षिप्रं शंसत मे प्रियम्। नलं पुरुषशार्दूलममित्रगणसूदनम्॥
en: Tell me without delay if you have seen my beloved husband, king Nala, the foremost of men and the slayer of his enemies."

sa: तच्चेदं फलमस्माकमपराधो न मे क्वचित्। इतिधीरोऽन्ववेक्ष्यैव नात्मानं तत्र गर्हयेत्।।
en: If however I do not meet with success I am not to blame thinking this he contents himself and does not reproach himself.

sa: स्पृष्टस्य त्र्यम्बकेणाथ फाल्गुनस्यामितौजसः। यत् किंचिदशुभं देहे तत् सर्वं नाशमीयिवत्॥
en: Whatever evil there was in the body of the immeasuraely energetic Falguni (Arjuna) was all dispelled by his touch with the three-eyed deity.

sa: अहं ह्येतावुभौ ब्रह्मन् कृष्णावरिविघातिनौ। अभिजानामि विक्रान्तौ तथा व्यासः प्रतापवान्॥
en: O Brahmana, I know them both, Krishna and Arjuna, those greatly powerful destroyers of enemies as much as the mighty Vyasa knows them.

sa: अभियानं तु वीरेण प्रद्युम्नेन महारणे। नामर्षयत संक्रुद्धः शाल्वः कुरुकुलोद्वह॥
en: O perpetua or of the Kuru race, challenged by the heroic Pradyumna in that great battle, the angry Shalva could not bear it.

sa: प्रणमाम्यभिगम्याहं राजपुत्रीं निबोध माम्। राज्ञः स्नुषां राजभार्यां दमयन्तीति विश्रुताम्॥
en: Approaching I bow down unto you. Know me for a kings' daughter, a king's daughter-inlaw, a king's wife and for Damayanti by name.

sa: अन्तर्भूमिगताश्चान्ये हयानां चरणान्यथ। व्यगृहणन् दानवा घोरा रथचक्रे च भारता॥
en: Other dreadful Danavas entering into the entrails of the earth, O Bharata, caught hold of the legs of the horses and the car-wheels.

sa: दशनागसहगाणिधारयन्ति हि यद् बलम्। तद् बलं भीमसेनस्य भुजयोरसमं परैः॥
en: The strength of Bhimasena's arms, which by far the most exceeded that of others, was equal to the might of ten thousand elephants.

sa: ततः संहृत्य मुष्टिं तु पञ्चशीर्षमिवोरगम्। वेगेनाभ्यहनद् भीमो राक्षसस्य शिरोधराम्॥
en: At last Bhima, clenching his fist like a five headed snake, dealt with great force a blow on the neck of the Rakshasa.

sa: प्रमत्तेष्वभिघातं हि कुर्याच्छाल्वो नराधिपः। इति कृत्वाप्रमत्तास्ते सर्वे वृष्ण्यन्धकाः स्थिताः॥
en: Well-knowing that they would be killed by king Shalva, if they became intoxicated all the Vrishnis and the Andhakas, remained sober and watchful.

sa: यच्चोक्तं विहगैर्हसैः समीपे तव भूभिप। मत्समक्षं यदुक्तं च तदवेक्षितुमर्हसि॥
en: O ruler of earth! you ought also to remember what the sky-ranging swans said before you and also what they declared before me.

sa: नाबिभ्यत् सा नृपसुता भैमी तत्राथ कस्यचित्। दारुणामटवीं प्राप्य भर्तृव्यसनपीडिता॥
en: Afflicted at her husband's calamity and having entered into that fearful forest, that princess, the daughter of Bhima, was not afraid of anything.

sa: वशे चक्रे महाबाहुर्भीमो भीमपराक्रमः। ततः सुपार्श्वमभितस्तथा राजपतिं क्रथम्॥ युध्यमानं बलात् संख्ये विजिग्ये पाण्डवर्षभः। ततो मत्स्यान् महातेजा मलदांश्च महाबलान्॥
en: And the mighty armed Bhima of fearful prowess brought him also under his sway. Then that best of the Pandavas by great force vanquished in battle Kratha who reigned (over and kingdom) near Suparshva. Then the greatly effulgent (hero) vanquished the Matsyas and the mighty Malavas.

sa: परासुश्च सुतो दृष्टः शप्तश्चेष्टः सखा मया। ईदृशीमापदं कोऽत्र द्वितीयोऽनुभविष्यति॥
en: Having seen my son dead, I have cursed my dearest friend. What second man is there who mects with such a (grcat) calamity.

sa: सूदयेम महाबाहो देशकालो ह्ययं नृप। क्षत्रधर्मस्य सम्प्राप्तः कालः सत्यपराक्रमः॥
en: O mighty-armed king, O hero of great prowess, this is the (proper) time and place which has come to display our Kshatriya prowess.

sa: अहो बत महद्भूतं स्वयंभूर्यदिदं स्वयम्। आदास्यति पुनः क्षत्रमेवं बलसमन्वितम्॥
en: "Oh! what could be greater wonder than that the self-creates himself will take away (from earth) all these Kshatriyas endued with great strength.

sa: भोजनाच्छादने चैषां नित्यं मे श्वशुराः स्थितः। रामप्रभृतयः सर्वे भजन्त्यन्धकवृष्णयः॥
en: My mother-in-law is ever attentive in feeding and clothing them. All the Anddhakas and Vrishnis with Rama and others love them very much.

sa: एष नार्थविहीनेन शक्यो राजन् निषेवितुम्। अखिलाः पुरुषव्याघ्र गुणाः स्युर्यद्यपीतरे॥
en: But, O foremost of men, these virtues, cannot be attained by one that has no wealth, even if he possess infinite other accomplishments.
